paragraphs.en: The controls show the zero is not the mark of a strict instrument. The three control properties check the instrument itself. They are properties any active project acquires, chosen before any control cell was scored and scored by the same passes under the same rule. They come back filled: 28 of the 48 control cells are present at the pinned commits. No control sits materially below the five architectural properties across the population. §3 reports this as the instrument not separating architecture from ordinary engineering activity. Two caveats apply. We wrote the control rubrics after the architectural results were in, which if anything favours controls that behave differently from the architectural properties; they did not. And the architectural properties were scored before the controls existed, so the controls could not have shaped those scores. So the instrument reaches present readily where nothing is at stake, and the zero across the thirty-two absent-reader cells is an absence.
paragraphs.zh: 这些控制项表明，零并非严格仪器的标志。 这三个控制属性用于检验仪器本身。 它们是任何活跃项目都会获得的属性，在任何一个控制单元被评分之前就已选定，并且是在相同规则下通过相同的步骤进行评分的。 它们最终被填满：在 48 个控制单元中，有 28 个出现在已固定的提交中。 在整个样本集中，没有任何一个控制项在实质上低于五个架构属性。第 3 节报告称，这表明该仪器未能将架构与普通的工程活动区分开来。但有两个注意事项需要说明。 我们是在获得架构结果之后才编写这些控制标准的，这从某种意义上说更倾向于那些行为与架构属性不同的控制项；然而它们并未如此表现。 而且，这些架构属性的评分是在控制项出现之前完成的，因此控制项不可能影响这些评分。 因此，在没有利害关系的情况下，该仪器能轻松得出当前结果；而在三十二个无读者单元中出现的零，则代表一种缺失状态。

paragraphs.en: On a finer ladder, no framework reaches a second writer (preregistration Addendum 42). A single band cannot show how far short a framework falls. So after scoring, each framework was scored once more on a five-rung ladder, by the same instrument, tools and evidence rule, three blinded passes each. The rubric and predictions were registered before the first pass. The rungs are:
paragraphs.zh: 在更精细的阶梯上，没有任何框架能达到第二个层级（预注册附录 42）。 单个层级无法显示一个框架与理想状态之间的差距有多大。 因此，在评分之后，每个框架都使用相同的工具、方法和证据规则，通过三次盲评，在五级阶梯上再次进行评分。 评分标准与预测结果在第一轮评估前就已登记。各层级为：

sents.en: On a finer ladder, no framework reaches a second writer (preregistration Addendum 42).
sents.zh: 在更精细的阶梯上，没有任何框架能达到第二个层级（预注册附录 42）。

sents.zh: 因此，在评分之后，每个框架都使用相同的工具、方法和证据规则，通过三次盲评，在五级阶梯上再次进行评分。

sents.en: The rubric and predictions were registered before the first pass. The rungs are:
sents.zh: 评分标准与预测结果在第一轮评估前就已登记。各层级为：

paragraphs.en: rung 0: no durable record, or one the runtime rewrites or deletes in normal operation;
paragraphs.zh: 第 0 层：没有持久记录，或者存在一个在正常运行时会被运行时环境重写或删除的记录；

paragraphs.en: rung 1: a single-writer append-only record, a checksum or chain the runtime computes over it included;
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 层：一个单写者追加式记录，其中包含运行时计算得出的校验和或链；

paragraphs.en: rung 2: a second writer outside the runtime, reconciled;
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 层：一个位于运行时之外的第二个智能体，已协调一致；

paragraphs.en: rung 3: rung 2 with an externally anchored head;
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 级：在第 2 级的基础上增加一个外部锚定的头部；

paragraphs.en: All 48 passes carried located evidence. Fourteen frameworks sit at rung 0 and two at rung 1; one of the two, deepseek-harness, has a checksum it computes over its own record. None reaches rung 2, as predicted before the first pass (P42.1: none at rung 2; P42.3: at most three with a self-computed checksum). Prediction P42.2 held only in part. It said all three frameworks partial on the tamper-evident property sit at rung 1, but only deepseek-harness does. The reason is that the band scores the audit log and the ladder the session record. Cline and moatless-tools each keep an append-only audit log ( hooks.jsonl , events.jsonl ), which makes them partial on the property. They also rewrite or delete their session records in normal operation, which puts them at rung 0. Aider’s passes split 0, 1, 1. Its chat history is only ever appended, but it is an ordinary file, and the rubric left open whether that is rung 0 or 1.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 48 次传递都携带了证据。 有 14 个框架位于第 0 级，2 个位于第 1 级；其中一个是 deepseek-harness，它会对自己记录的内容计算校验和。 如首次传递前所预测的那样（P42.1：没有框架位于第 2 级；P42.3：最多有 3 个框架具备自计算校验和），没有任何一个框架达到第 2 级。 预测 P42.2 仅部分成立。 该说明指出，所有三个在篡改可检测性属性上仅部分满足的框架都位于第 1 级，但只有 deepseek-harness 确实如此。 原因是该带对审计日志进行评分，而该阶梯则对会话记录进行评分。 Cline 和 moatless-tools 各自维护一个只追加式审计日志（hooks.jsonl、events.jsonl），这使得它们在篡改可检测性属性上仅部分满足要求。 在正常运行中，它们还会重写或删除自己的会话记录，这使它们处于第 0 级。 Aider 的传递结果分为 0、1、1。 其聊天历史只会追加内容，但它是一个普通文件，而评分标准并未明确说明这属于第 0 级还是第 1 级。

sents.zh: 所有 48 次传递都携带了证据。

paragraphs.en: Reproduction. Four scripts reproduce the second-instrument check. A pinned commit is the commit a framework was scored at (Table 4 ). A blobless checkout is a clone with full commit history whose file contents are fetched only for the commit checked out. A majority is the band at least two of a cell’s three passes returned.
paragraphs.zh: 复现。 四个脚本复现了第二工具检查。 已固定的提交是框架在评分时所用的提交（表4）。 无Blob的检出是一种完整的提交历史克隆，其文件内容仅针对检出的提交进行获取。 多数是指一个单元的三个通道中至少有两个返回的结果范围。

sents.en: Reproduction.
sents.zh: 复现。

sents.en: Four scripts reproduce the second-instrument check.
sents.zh: 四个脚本复现了第二工具检查。

sents.en: A pinned commit is the commit a framework was scored at (Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 已固定的提交是框架在评分时所用的提交（表4）。

sents.en: A blobless checkout is a clone with full commit history whose file contents are fetched only for the commit checked out.
sents.zh: 无Blob的检出是一种完整的提交历史克隆，其文件内容仅针对检出的提交进行获取。

sents.en: A majority is the band at least two of a cell’s three passes returned.
sents.zh: 多数是指一个单元的三个通道中至少有两个返回的结果范围。

paragraphs.en: ds_pass.py scores one pass: a blinded, tool-using read of one framework for one property over its blobless checkout at the pinned commit. It uses no location index and saves the pass as one JSON file. It keeps a pass only if the pass meets the citation rule the reported grid was held to: every cited path exists in the checkout, inside the product’s subtree.
paragraphs.zh: ds_pass.py 生成一个通过记录：针对某个属性，在已固定提交的无 blob 检出中，对某个框架进行一次盲态工具使用读取。 它不使用位置索引，并将该通过记录保存为一个 JSON 文件。 仅当该通过记录满足所报告网格所遵循的引用规则时，它才会保留此记录：所有被引用的路径都必须存在于检出的产品子树中。

sents.en: ds_pass.py scores one pass: a blinded, tool-using read of one framework for one property over its blobless checkout at the pinned commit.
sents.zh: ds_pass.py 生成一个通过记录：针对某个属性，在已固定提交的无 blob 检出中，对某个框架进行一次盲态工具使用读取。

sents.en: It uses no location index and saves the pass as one JSON file.
sents.zh: 它不使用位置索引，并将该通过记录保存为一个 JSON 文件。

sents.en: It keeps a pass only if the pass meets the citation rule the reported grid was held to: every cited path exists in the checkout, inside the product’s subtree.
sents.zh: 仅当该通过记录满足所报告网格所遵循的引用规则时，它才会保留此记录：所有被引用的路径都必须存在于检出的产品子树中。

paragraphs.en: build_grid_deepseek.py turns each cell’s three passes into a majority and writes the cross-vendor grid.
paragraphs.zh: build_grid_deepseek.py 将每个单元格的三次遍历结果转换为多数值，并写入跨厂商网格。

paragraphs.en: critic_gpt.py runs the critic , a second model that reads every absent cell and names the files a miss would live in. ds_pass.py --rescan then re-scans each named cell with three fresh passes handed those files, and the grid is rebuilt.
paragraphs.zh: critic_gpt.py 运行了评论者模型，这是一个第二模型，它会读取每个缺失的单元格，并为那些缺失文件本应存放的位置命名。随后，ds_pass.py --rescan 会重新扫描每个已命名的单元格，使用三个新的处理步骤处理这些文件，然后重建网格。

paragraphs.en: deepseek_agreement.py compares that grid with the reported grid ( scale/master-grid.json ) and writes the agreement file and the blind disagreement sheet. The critic’s inputs and verdicts sit under scale/critic-input-deepseek/ . Its counts: 129 of 160 cells agree exactly, 31 of the 32 gap cells agree, and no gap cell is present .
paragraphs.zh: deepseek_agreement.py 将那个网格与报告中的网格（scale/master-grid.json）进行比较，并生成一致性文件和无视不一致性表。 评论者的输入和裁决位于 scale/critic-input-deepseek/ 目录下。 其统计结果如下：160 个单元格中有 129 个完全一致，32 个间隙单元格中有 31 个一致，且不存在任何间隙单元格。

sents.en: deepseek_agreement.py compares that grid with the reported grid ( scale/master-grid.json ) and writes the agreement file and the blind disagreement sheet.
sents.zh: deepseek_agreement.py 将那个网格与报告中的网格（scale/master-grid.json）进行比较，并生成一致性文件和无视不一致性表。

paragraphs.en: The task set of §4.1 holds fourteen tasks: eight prototypes and six SWE-bench Verified derivations. The eight prototypes re-implement production failure mechanisms in fresh minimal repositories with synthetic data.
paragraphs.zh: §4.1 中定义的任务集包含十四项任务：八个原型和六个 SWE-bench 验证过的派生任务。 这八个原型在包含合成数据的全新最小仓库中重新实现了生产环境中的故障机制。

sents.zh: §4.1 中定义的任务集包含十四项任务：八个原型和六个 SWE-bench 验证过的派生任务。

sents.en: The eight prototypes re-implement production failure mechanisms in fresh minimal repositories with synthetic data.
sents.zh: 这八个原型在包含合成数据的全新最小仓库中重新实现了生产环境中的故障机制。

paragraphs.en: The six SWE-bench tasks are the lowest eligible issue id in each of three repositories, plus the next lowest in each. They were picked by a content-blind rule, frozen before any run, so that no task could be chosen for what its mechanism looks like (Appendix H , entry of 2026-08-28). The rule draws on the instances of SWE-bench Verified annotated 15 minutes to 1 hour in the pure-Python repositories. It keeps the three repositories with the most eligible instances (django, sphinx, pytest), and within each it takes the lowest numeric issue id. A pre-registered substitution queue, in the same order, replaces any instance that fails the entry check. The three added after registration are the next lowest eligible id in each repository, the head of each queue. In sphinx the first two failed the entry check and were replaced by the third, 8035.
paragraphs.zh: 六个 SWE-bench 任务分别是三个仓库中符合条件的最低问题 ID，以及每个仓库中次低的 ID。 这些任务是根据一个与内容无关的规则选定的，并在任何运行之前就已确定，因此不会因任务的机制特征而选择任何任务（附录 H，2026-08-28 条目）。 该规则参考了纯 Python 仓库中经过“15 分钟至 1 小时”标注的 SWE-bench Verified 实例。 它保留拥有最多合格实例的三个仓库（django、sphinx、pytest），并在每个仓库内选取数值最低的问题 ID。 一个预先注册的替换队列会按相同顺序取代任何未通过准入检查的实例。 注册后添加的三个任务是每个仓库中符合条件的次低 ID，即每个队列的首项。 在 sphinx 中，前两项未通过准入检查，因此被第三项（8035）所取代。

paragraphs.en: Every task passes four gates: the entry test fails at base, passes with the reference fix, fails again on revert, and behaves identically without network access. Each key also lists the facts that establish the mechanism without relying on anything the agent said.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都会经过四个关卡：初始测试在基础阶段失败，使用参考修复后通过，但在回滚时再次失败，并且在没有网络访问的情况下表现完全相同。 每个关键项还列出了确立该机制的事实，而这些事实并不依赖于智能体所说的任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy grading (§5.1) covers all fourteen tasks, and dropping the three starred tasks barely moves it. Their keys were written after the examinations, from the upstream gold patches, so for those tasks the answers precede the keys; each key’s provenance header says so. Without those three tasks, native attribution under grader 1 is 99% for E1 (109 of 110), against 97% on all fourteen. For E2 it is 78% (86 of 110), against 76%. No condition moves by more than 4.4 points under grader 1 or grader 2. The E1 to E2 gap under native goes from 21.4 to 20.9 points ( bench/exam/KEYS-SENSITIVITY.md ).
paragraphs.zh: 准确性评分（§5.1）涵盖了全部十四项任务，而移除三项带星号的任务几乎不会改变这一结果。 这些答案的参考答案是在考试之后根据上游的黄金样本编写的，因此对于这些任务，答案出现在参考答案之前；每个参考答案的来源说明中都有明确标注。 如果不包括这三项任务，在评分员1的评估下，E1 的母语者归属准确率高达 99%（110 个中的 109 个），而全部十四项任务的准确率为 97%。 对于 E2，这一准确率为 78%（110 个中的 86 个），而全部十四项任务的准确率为 76%。 在评分员1或评分员2的评估下，没有任何一种情况的变化超过 4.4 分。 母语者评估中 E1 与 E2 之间的差距从 21.4 分缩小到 20.9 分（bench/exam/KEYS-SENSITIVITY.md）。

paragraphs.en: Two mechanical steps turn each harness’s native record into the examiner bundles of §4.3, a bundle being the set of files one condition hands the examiner (Table 6 ). The first, extraction, runs on every record. It removes only packaging: repeated copies of identical content, binary containers, and task infrastructure picked up by the collection rule, which takes every file under the run’s home and workspace. For mini-swe-agent and SWE-agent, whose records repeat themselves, that de-duplication happens at extraction for every bundle. Extraction never removes content that appears once. The second step, folding, runs only when a bundle does not fit an examiner’s context. It replaces repeated content with a placeholder carrying a content hash. Unlike extraction, folding can elide content that appears once, and it records what it elided. The folding factor is reported as a result.
paragraphs.zh: 两个机械步骤将每个 harness 的原始记录转换为 §4.3 中所述的审查员包，其中每个包是一个条件向审查员移交的文件集合（表 6）。 第一步是提取，该步骤针对每条记录执行。 它仅移除包装内容：即重复出现的相同内容副本、二进制容器以及收集规则所识别的任务基础设施，该规则会获取运行所在主目录和工作空间下的所有文件。 对于 mini-swe-agent 和 SWE-agent，由于其记录存在自我重复，因此每个包的提取阶段都会执行去重操作。 提取步骤绝不会移除仅出现一次的内容。 第二步是折叠，仅当某个包无法适配审查员的上下文时才会执行。 该步骤会用一个携带内容哈希的占位符来替换重复内容。 与提取不同，折叠可以省略仅出现一次的内容，并且会记录其省略的具体内容。 折叠因子会被作为结果报告出来。

paragraphs.en: The table is the condition. The assembler inlines every file in the bundle directory, so Table 6 lists exactly what each condition hands the examiner. Ceiling carries the same three kinds of material as native+ledger, plus the derived decision list. On ten of the 140, its record and ledger are folded further than the native copies, because those bundles were over the window. Ceiling still lacks the operator stream, so it is not a superset of trace.

paragraphs.en: Four properties hold the extractor to account. Extraction is held to no discretion, determinism, auditability and uniformity, so that anyone can rebuild the bundles and check them. No discretion: the extractor addresses fixed paths, fixed table names and content fingerprints, and holds no judgement about what matters. Determinism: a re-run over the frozen corpus produces byte-identical output. Every file written is recorded with its length and its SHA-256 in a per-bundle manifest. Auditability: the original artefacts travel with the release, and their hashes tie to the corpus index. A reader can therefore re-run the extractor and reconcile. Uniformity: one script covers the five harnesses. Per harness it knows only the path the record is written to and the one fixed operation for that format, below.
paragraphs.zh: 四个特性使提取器具有可问责性。 提取过程严格遵循无裁量权、确定性、可审计性和统一性原则，因此任何人都可以重建数据包并进行验证。 无裁量权：提取器处理固定的路径、表名和内容指纹，不对任何内容的重要性做出判断。 确定性：对冻结语料库重新运行提取过程，将产生字节完全相同的输出。 每个写入的文件都会通过其长度和 SHA-256 哈希值记录在每包清单中。 可审计性：原始工件随发布版本一同提供，其哈希值与语料库索引相关联。 因此，读取者可以重新运行提取器并进行核对。 统一性：一个脚本即可覆盖全部五个工具集。 对于每个工具集，它仅知道记录被写入的路径以及该格式对应的唯一固定操作（见下文）。

sents.en: Four properties hold the extractor to account.
sents.zh: 四个特性使提取器具有可问责性。

sents.en: Determinism: a re-run over the frozen corpus produces byte-identical output.
sents.zh: 确定性：对冻结语料库重新运行提取过程，将产生字节完全相同的输出。

sents.en: Every file written is recorded with its length and its SHA-256 in a per-bundle manifest.

sents.en: A reader can therefore re-run the extractor and reconcile.

sents.en: Uniformity: one script covers the five harnesses.
sents.zh: 统一性：一个脚本即可覆盖全部五个工具集。

sents.en: Per harness it knows only the path the record is written to and the one fixed operation for that format, below.
sents.zh: 对于每个工具集，它仅知道记录被写入的路径以及该格式对应的唯一固定操作（见下文）。

paragraphs.en: Each harness’s record gets one fixed operation. Every path named here is inside the run’s isolated home or workspace. aider leaves .aider.chat.history.md and .aider.input.history as dotfiles in the workspace. Both are already text and are copied unchanged. cline writes the session JSON and the messages JSON under the session directory, also copied unchanged. opencode writes opencode.db , a SQLite database with a write-ahead log. Extraction merges that log, then dumps the event , message , part and session tables as text in that fixed order, dropping nothing. mini-swe-agent writes last_mini_run.traj.json , and SWE-agent writes the run’s .traj file under trajectories/ . Each becomes a JSON view with repeated blocks of 256 bytes or more replaced by a fingerprint.
paragraphs.zh: 每个约束装置的记录都会获得一次固定操作。 此处命名的每条路径都位于运行实例的隔离主目录或工作空间内。aider 会将 .aider.chat.history.md 和 .aider.input.history 作为点文件保留在工作空间中。 两者都已经是文本，且会被原样复制。cline 会将会话 JSON 和消息 JSON 写入会话目录，同样也原样复制。opencode 会写入 opencode.db，这是一个带有写前日志的 SQLite 数据库。 Extraction 会合并该日志，然后以固定顺序将事件、消息、部分和会话表以文本形式导出，不丢弃任何内容。mini-swe-agent 会写入 last_mini_run.traj.json，而 SWE-agent 会将运行实例的 .traj 文件写入 trajectories/ 目录下。 每个文件都会变成一个 JSON 视图，其中重复出现的 256 字节或更多长度的区块会被替换为指纹。

sents.en: Each harness’s record gets one fixed operation.
sents.zh: 每个约束装置的记录都会获得一次固定操作。

sents.en: Every path named here is inside the run’s isolated home or workspace. aider leaves .aider.chat.history.md and .aider.input.history as dotfiles in the workspace.
sents.zh: 此处命名的每条路径都位于运行实例的隔离主目录或工作空间内。aider 会将 .aider.chat.history.md 和 .aider.input.history 作为点文件保留在工作空间中。

sents.en: Both are already text and are copied unchanged. cline writes the session JSON and the messages JSON under the session directory, also copied unchanged. opencode writes opencode.db , a SQLite database with a write-ahead log.
sents.zh: 两者都已经是文本，且会被原样复制。cline 会将会话 JSON 和消息 JSON 写入会话目录，同样也原样复制。opencode 会写入 opencode.db，这是一个带有写前日志的 SQLite 数据库。

sents.en: Extraction merges that log, then dumps the event , message , part and session tables as text in that fixed order, dropping nothing. mini-swe-agent writes last_mini_run.traj.json , and SWE-agent writes the run’s .traj file under trajectories/ .
sents.zh: Extraction 会合并该日志，然后以固定顺序将事件、消息、部分和会话表以文本形式导出，不丢弃任何内容。mini-swe-agent 会写入 last_mini_run.traj.json，而 SWE-agent 会将运行实例的 .traj 文件写入 trajectories/ 目录下。

sents.en: Each becomes a JSON view with repeated blocks of 256 bytes or more replaced by a fingerprint.
sents.zh: 每个文件都会变成一个 JSON 视图，其中重复出现的 256 字节或更多长度的区块会被替换为指纹。

paragraphs.en: The two trajectory formats are de-duplicated at extraction, always. Both re-embed the whole conversation at every step. This is the only place extraction removes anything from the record itself, and it removes only blocks already in the bundle. A string of 256 bytes or more that has already appeared is replaced by a placeholder carrying the first sixteen hex digits of its SHA-256. The first occurrence is kept in full. This is rule N1 of the folding below, applied to these two formats unconditionally, whether or not the bundle fits. Shorter strings, such as key names and short commands, are kept as written. The threshold is frozen and ships with the script.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种轨迹格式在提取时始终会进行去重处理。 两者在每个步骤都会对整个对话进行重新嵌入。 这是提取过程唯一会从记录本身移除内容的位置，且仅移除数据集中已存在的区块。 长度达到或超过 256 字节且已出现过的字符串，将被替换为一个占位符，该占位符包含其 SHA-256 哈希值的前十六个十六进制数字。 首次出现的字符串将完整保留。 这是下文折叠规则中的规则 N1，无论数据集是否容纳得下，都会无条件应用于这两种格式。 较短的字符串（如键名和简短命令）将按原样保留。 该阈值是固定的，并随脚本一同发布。

sents.zh: 这两种轨迹格式在提取时始终会进行去重处理。

sents.zh: 首次出现的字符串将完整保留。

sents.zh: 这是下文折叠规则中的规则 N1，无论数据集是否容纳得下，都会无条件应用于这两种格式。

paragraphs.en: Extraction removes packaging, never content that appears once. Removal is confined to three kinds of packaging. First, repeated copies of content already in the bundle. Second, binary containers, such as one harness’s snapshot object store, which is listed as a directory instead. Third, task infrastructure picked up by the collection rule: the language toolchain, the virtual environment, the package cache and the model-capability caches. The workspace source tree is listed rather than inlined, because a SWE-bench repository is reference material and not part of the record. Every bundle carries a manifest naming what was excluded, the length and hash of every file written, and the source path each file came from. Every bundle that carries a record also gets three files: the entry test’s failing output before the run, the final workspace diff, and the workspace file-tree listing. The first two are the benchmark-written anchors of §4.2, written by neither the harness nor the examiner.
paragraphs.zh: 提取过程会移除包装，但绝不会移除仅出现一次的内容。 移除操作仅限于三种类型的包装。 第一类是包内已存在内容的重复副本。 第二类是二进制容器，例如某个测试框架的快照对象存储，它实际上会被列为一个目录。 第三类是被收集规则捕获的任务基础设施：语言工具链、虚拟环境、包缓存以及模型能力缓存。 工作区源树会被列出而非内联，因为 SWE-bench 仓库属于参考材料，而非记录的一部分。 每个包都携带一个清单，其中注明了被排除的内容、每份已写入文件的长度和哈希值，以及每份文件的来源路径。 每个包含记录的文件包还会附带三个文件：运行前入口测试的失败输出、最终的工作区差异，以及工作区的文件树列表。 前两项是 §4.2 中由基准测试编写的锚点，既非测试框架也非考官所编写。

sents.zh: 提取过程会移除包装，但绝不会移除仅出现一次的内容。

sents.zh: 移除操作仅限于三种类型的包装。

sents.zh: 第一类是包内已存在内容的重复副本。

sents.zh: 第二类是二进制容器，例如某个测试框架的快照对象存储，它实际上会被列为一个目录。

sents.en: Third, task infrastructure picked up by the collection rule: the language toolchain, the virtual environment, the package cache and the model-capability caches.
sents.zh: 第三类是被收集规则捕获的任务基础设施：语言工具链、虚拟环境、包缓存以及模型能力缓存。

sents.zh: 每个包含记录的文件包还会附带三个文件：运行前入口测试的失败输出、最终的工作区差异，以及工作区的文件树列表。

sents.en: The first two are the benchmark-written anchors of §4.2, written by neither the harness nor the examiner.
sents.zh: 前两项是 §4.2 中由基准测试编写的锚点，既非测试框架也非考官所编写。

paragraphs.en: Folding runs only when a bundle would not fit. A bundle over one million estimated tokens is folded. Tokens are estimated as bytes / 3.5 × \times 1.95. The factor of 1.95 corrects an undercount: on four bundles, bytes / 3.5 alone undercounted the examiner’s own token count by a factor of 1.85 to 2.08. Five mechanical rules do the folding: R1 to R3 on the ledger as presented, and N1 and N2 on the native record.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在某个捆绑包无法容纳时才会进行折叠。 估计超过一百万个标记的捆绑包会被折叠。 标记按字节数 / 3.5 × \times 1.95 进行估算。 1.95 这个系数用于修正低估问题：在四个捆绑包中，仅使用字节数 / 3.5 的计算方式，比审查员自身的标记计数低估了 1.85 到 2.08 倍。 有五条机械规则负责折叠：R1 至 R3 适用于所呈现的账本，N1 和 N2 则适用于原始记录。

sents.en: Folding runs only when a bundle would not fit.
sents.zh: 仅在某个捆绑包无法容纳时才会进行折叠。

sents.en: A bundle over one million estimated tokens is folded.
sents.zh: 估计超过一百万个标记的捆绑包会被折叠。

sents.en: Tokens are estimated as bytes / 3.5 × \times 1.95.
sents.zh: 标记按字节数 / 3.5 × \times 1.95 进行估算。

sents.en: The factor of 1.95 corrects an undercount: on four bundles, bytes / 3.5 alone undercounted the examiner’s own token count by a factor of 1.85 to 2.08.
sents.zh: 1.95 这个系数用于修正低估问题：在四个捆绑包中，仅使用字节数 / 3.5 的计算方式，比审查员自身的标记计数低估了 1.85 到 2.08 倍。

sents.en: Five mechanical rules do the folding: R1 to R3 on the ledger as presented, and N1 and N2 on the native record.
sents.zh: 有五条机械规则负责折叠：R1 至 R3 适用于所呈现的账本，N1 和 N2 则适用于原始记录。

paragraphs.en: R1 replaces an environment-side body in a ledger event that already appears verbatim in the same bundle, including under JSON escaping. In its place goes a placeholder carrying the body’s fingerprint, so the reader finds the original in the material.
paragraphs.zh: R1 会替换账本事件中一个环境侧的实体，该实体在同一个数据集中已以完全相同的形式出现，包括 JSON 转义部分。 取而代之的是一个占位符，其中包含该实体的指纹，这样读者就能在材料中找到原始内容。

sents.en: R1 replaces an environment-side body in a ledger event that already appears verbatim in the same bundle, including under JSON escaping.
sents.zh: R1 会替换账本事件中一个环境侧的实体，该实体在同一个数据集中已以完全相同的形式出现，包括 JSON 转义部分。

sents.en: In its place goes a placeholder carrying the body’s fingerprint, so the reader finds the original in the material.
sents.zh: 取而代之的是一个占位符，其中包含该实体的指纹，这样读者就能在材料中找到原始内容。

paragraphs.en: R2 shortens any hash column in the presentation copy of the ledger to its first sixteen hex digits, with the database as the authority for the full value.
paragraphs.zh: R2 会将账本展示副本中任何哈希列缩短为其前十六个十六进制数字，而数据库则是完整值的权威来源。

paragraphs.en: R3 replaces twenty or more consecutive ledger events of the same writer and kind with empty bodies by one summary row. That row names the sequence range, the count, the kind, and a fingerprint of the block.
paragraphs.zh: R3 将同一作者、同一种类的二十个或更多连续账本事件替换为一条摘要行，且该摘要行的内容为空。 该行会注明序列范围、数量、种类以及区块的指纹信息。

sents.en: R3 replaces twenty or more consecutive ledger events of the same writer and kind with empty bodies by one summary row.
sents.zh: R3 将同一作者、同一种类的二十个或更多连续账本事件替换为一条摘要行，且该摘要行的内容为空。

sents.en: That row names the sequence range, the count, the kind, and a fingerprint of the block.
sents.zh: 该行会注明序列范围、数量、种类以及区块的指纹信息。

paragraphs.en: N1 replaces a line of 256 bytes or more in a record file that has already appeared in that file with a placeholder carrying the line’s fingerprint.
paragraphs.zh: N1 会将记录文件中已经出现过的、长度达到或超过 256 字节的行，替换为包含该行指纹的占位符。

paragraphs.en: N2 keeps the first and last 8 KB of a record file over 256 KB and replaces the middle with a placeholder naming the byte count and a fingerprint.
paragraphs.zh: N2 会保留超过 256 KB 的记录文件中首尾各 8 KB 的内容，并用一个占位符替换中间部分，该占位符包含字节数和指纹信息。

paragraphs.en: Ceiling bundles still over the window after these rules received one further pass at tighter thresholds. That pass applies to the record and the ledger alike: 128-byte lines, 64 KB files, and 4 KB of head and tail.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些规则经过一轮更严格的阈值调整之后，天花板上的束带仍然覆盖着窗户。 这一轮调整同时适用于记录簿和账簿：128字节的行、64 KB的文件，以及4 KB的头部和尾部。

sents.en: Ceiling bundles still over the window after these rules received one further pass at tighter thresholds.
sents.zh: 在这些规则经过一轮更严格的阈值调整之后，天花板上的束带仍然覆盖着窗户。

sents.en: That pass applies to the record and the ledger alike: 128-byte lines, 64 KB files, and 4 KB of head and tail.
sents.zh: 这一轮调整同时适用于记录簿和账簿：128字节的行、64 KB的文件，以及4 KB的头部和尾部。

paragraphs.en: Every elision can be checked. Every placeholder names what it replaces and carries a fingerprint of it, so a reader holding the released originals can verify it. The ledger in the database is never folded, and the chain is verified against the database rather than against the presentation copy. The anchors and the derived decision list are never folded either. Placeholders do have a cost: they explain part of what E2 flags on clean copies. On SWE-agent, whose records are full of de-duplication placeholders, E2 flags 18 of the 20 clean copies. Across all pairs, placeholders raise its false-positive rate by about ten points (Table 25 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个省略都可以被核查。 每个占位符都标明了其所替代的内容，并携带着该内容的指纹信息，因此持有已发布的原始文本的读者可以对此进行验证。 数据库中的账本绝不会被折叠，且链式结构是依据数据库而非展示副本进行验证的。 锚点以及派生出的决策列表也绝不会被折叠。 占位符确实存在成本：它们解释了 E2 在干净副本中标记的部分内容。 在 SWE-agent 中，其记录充满了去重占位符，E2 对 20 个干净副本中的 18 个进行了标记。 在所有配对中，占位符使其误报率上升了约十个百分点（表 25）。

sents.en: Every elision can be checked.
sents.zh: 每个省略都可以被核查。

sents.en: Every placeholder names what it replaces and carries a fingerprint of it, so a reader holding the released originals can verify it.
sents.zh: 每个占位符都标明了其所替代的内容，并携带着该内容的指纹信息，因此持有已发布的原始文本的读者可以对此进行验证。

sents.zh: 数据库中的账本绝不会被折叠，且链式结构是依据数据库而非展示副本进行验证的。

sents.en: The anchors and the derived decision list are never folded either.
sents.zh: 锚点以及派生出的决策列表也绝不会被折叠。

sents.en: Placeholders do have a cost: they explain part of what E2 flags on clean copies.
sents.zh: 占位符确实存在成本：它们解释了 E2 在干净副本中标记的部分内容。

sents.en: On SWE-agent, whose records are full of de-duplication placeholders, E2 flags 18 of the 20 clean copies.
sents.zh: 在 SWE-agent 中，其记录充满了去重占位符，E2 对 20 个干净副本中的 18 个进行了标记。

sents.en: Across all pairs, placeholders raise its false-positive rate by about ten points (Table 25 ).
sents.zh: 在所有配对中，占位符使其误报率上升了约十个百分点（表 25）。

paragraphs.en: Folding is recorded per bundle and reported. The ledger manifest’s fold field records the rows before and after, the number of units folded, and the bytes on each side. The material manifest’s elision field records the same per file. Before folding, twenty bundles exceed the window. After it, none does on its record alone: the largest is under 400k tokens, and the one that had reached 1.54M falls to 105k. Eight E1 and seven E2 ceiling bundles still exceed the window once their decision lists are added, and are excluded (App. F ). Folding shows up twice in the results. The first is in what E2 flags on clean records (§5.3). The second is in 15 of the 19 clean-copy mismatches the reconciliation query reports. The other four are tool outputs cline cut to 8,000 characters before sending them to the model. There the witnessed unit is the cut form, and the record holds the full one (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 折叠按每个束单独记录并报告。 账本清单的折叠字段记录了折叠前后的行、折叠的单位数量以及每侧的字节数。 材料清单的省略字段按每个文件记录相同的信息。 在折叠之前，有二十个束超过了窗口限制。 折叠之后，没有任何一个记录单独超过该限制：最大的不足 40 万个词元，而原本达到 154 万个词元的则降至 10.5 万个。 八个 E1 和七个 E2 上限束在加入其决策列表后仍会超过窗口限制，因此被排除（附录 F）。 折叠在结果中出现了两次。 第一次出现在 E2 对干净记录标记的部分（§5.3）。 第二次出现在对账查询报告的 19 处干净副本不匹配中的 15 处。 其余四处是工具输出，在发送给模型前被截断至 8,000 个字符。 在这些情况下，所观察到的单位是截断后的形式，而记录中保留的是完整版本（附录 G）。

sents.en: Folding is recorded per bundle and reported.
sents.zh: 折叠按每个束单独记录并报告。

sents.en: The ledger manifest’s fold field records the rows before and after, the number of units folded, and the bytes on each side.
sents.zh: 账本清单的折叠字段记录了折叠前后的行、折叠的单位数量以及每侧的字节数。

sents.en: The material manifest’s elision field records the same per file.
sents.zh: 材料清单的省略字段按每个文件记录相同的信息。

sents.en: Before folding, twenty bundles exceed the window.
sents.zh: 在折叠之前，有二十个束超过了窗口限制。

sents.en: After it, none does on its record alone: the largest is under 400k tokens, and the one that had reached 1.54M falls to 105k.
sents.zh: 折叠之后，没有任何一个记录单独超过该限制：最大的不足 40 万个词元，而原本达到 154 万个词元的则降至 10.5 万个。

sents.en: Eight E1 and seven E2 ceiling bundles still exceed the window once their decision lists are added, and are excluded (App. F ).
sents.zh: 八个 E1 和七个 E2 上限束在加入其决策列表后仍会超过窗口限制，因此被排除（附录 F）。

sents.en: Folding shows up twice in the results.
sents.zh: 折叠在结果中出现了两次。

sents.en: The first is in what E2 flags on clean records (§5.3).
sents.zh: 第一次出现在 E2 对干净记录标记的部分（§5.3）。

sents.en: The second is in 15 of the 19 clean-copy mismatches the reconciliation query reports.
sents.zh: 第二次出现在对账查询报告的 19 处干净副本不匹配中的 15 处。

sents.en: The other four are tool outputs cline cut to 8,000 characters before sending them to the model.
sents.zh: 其余四处是工具输出，在发送给模型前被截断至 8,000 个字符。

sents.en: There the witnessed unit is the cut form, and the record holds the full one (Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 在这些情况下，所观察到的单位是截断后的形式，而记录中保留的是完整版本（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: The full extraction and folding rule text ships with the released pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的提取和折叠规则文本随发布的流程一同提供。

paragraphs.en: A citation is graded by where its excerpt lands, never by the examiner’s own label for it. This section gives the landing-site rules that grade every citation of §4.3, and the adversarial gate that the Q3 injection of §5.3 had to pass. A citation’s landing site is the file, and the row or field in it, that holds the cited excerpt. The fragment matcher is the routine that finds the excerpt there: verbatim, verbatim under JSON escaping, or as ordered fragments where the examiner’s quote has an ellipsis.
paragraphs.zh: 引文的评分依据是其摘录所处的位置，而非评审员为其添加的标签。 本节介绍了用于评估 §4.3 中所有引文的“落地位置”规则，以及 §5.3 中的 Q3 注入必须通过的对抗性关卡。 引文的落地位置是指包含所引用摘录的文件及其中的行或字段。 片段匹配器是用于定位该处摘录的程序：可以是逐字匹配、在 JSON 转义下的逐字匹配，或者当评审员的引文包含省略号时作为有序片段进行匹配。

sents.en: A citation is graded by where its excerpt lands, never by the examiner’s own label for it.
sents.zh: 引文的评分依据是其摘录所处的位置，而非评审员为其添加的标签。

sents.en: This section gives the landing-site rules that grade every citation of §4.3, and the adversarial gate that the Q3 injection of §5.3 had to pass.
sents.zh: 本节介绍了用于评估 §4.3 中所有引文的“落地位置”规则，以及 §5.3 中的 Q3 注入必须通过的对抗性关卡。

sents.en: A citation’s landing site is the file, and the row or field in it, that holds the cited excerpt.
sents.zh: 引文的落地位置是指包含所引用摘录的文件及其中的行或字段。

sents.en: The fragment matcher is the routine that finds the excerpt there: verbatim, verbatim under JSON escaping, or as ordered fragments where the examiner’s quote has an ellipsis.
sents.zh: 片段匹配器是用于定位该处摘录的程序：可以是逐字匹配、在 JSON 转义下的逐字匹配，或者当评审员的引文包含省略号时作为有序片段进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: The body’s numbers come from two pipelines, listed with their results files in the table below. Citation scoring is bench/exam/score_citations.py , which score_grid.py drives over every examiner answer file; it writes GRID-SCORES.json , the source of the corroborated shares of Table 1 . The alteration gate starts from bench/tamper/inject.py , which writes the clean and the altered copy of each record. Then redteam.py shows each pair to the gate model and writes redteam-window.json , and redteam_deepseek.py repeats that with the second judge. They give 57.5% for the first gate and 60.9% for the second (§5.3).
paragraphs.zh: 身体数据来自两个流程，其结果文件在下面的表格中列出。 引用评分由 bench/exam/score_citations.py 执行，该脚本由 score_grid.py 针对每个考官答案文件运行；它会生成 GRID-SCORES.json，即表 1 中经证实份额的来源。 修改门控流程始于 bench/tamper/inject.py，该脚本会写出每条记录的原始版本和修改后的副本。 接着，redteam.py 将每对记录展示给门控模型，并生成 redteam-window.json；而 redteam_deepseek.py 则使用第二个评判员重复此过程。 它们对第一个门控的评分为 57.5%，对第二个门控的评分为 60.9%（§5.3）。

paragraphs.en: Each citation gets two scores. The first is verifiability: the excerpt must appear in the cited file, verbatim, verbatim under JSON escaping, or as ordered fragments split on ellipses. A citation that passes is located (“located verbatim” in Table 1 ). One that fails is unsupported and counts against the examiner’s verifiability figure. The second is evidence grade, a function of the landing site alone. The examiner’s self-label is recorded but never used, so an examiner cannot raise its own grade. The landing rules, in full:
paragraphs.zh: 每个引用都会获得两个分数。 第一个是可验证性：该引文必须出现在被引用的文件中，且必须逐字完全一致（在 JSON 转义情况下也需完全一致），或作为以省略号分隔的有序片段出现。 通过验证的引用会被标记为“已定位”（见表 1 中的“已逐字定位”）。 未通过验证的引用则被视为无依据，并会扣减审查员的可验证性得分。 第二个是证据等级，仅取决于落地位置。 审查员的自我标签会被记录，但绝不会被使用，因此审查员无法提升自身的等级。 完整的落地规则如下：

paragraphs.en: Two model readers mostly agree with the rules. Two models were shown the same 100 sampled citations: the grader’s (claude-haiku-4-5, E1’s vendor) and E3’s (deepseek-v4-pro). They agreed with the rules 72% and 68% of the time, and with each other on 90 of 100. Where they disagreed with the rules, the disagreement was symmetric in direction. A 100-citation human verification list ships with the data ; human annotators rated the same 100, single-rater on 90 and by majority on the ten shared (results in the human-panel paragraph of Appendix F ) .
paragraphs.zh: 两个模型阅读器大多同意这些规则。 两个模型被展示了相同的 100 条采样引用：评分者的（claude-haiku-4-5，E1 的供应商）和 E3 的（deepseek-v4-pro）。 它们 72% 和 68% 的情况下同意这些规则，并且在 100 条中 90 条上彼此一致。 在它们不同意规则的地方，分歧的方向是对称的。 一份包含 100 条引用的人类验证列表随数据一同提供；人类标注员对相同的 100 条进行了评分，其中 90 条由单个评分员评分，其余 10 条则由多数投票决定（结果见附录 F 中“人类评审团”段落）。

paragraphs.en: Two rules were tightened after examination, and both lowered a share. The unlocatable rule never corroborates a ledger row the fragment matcher cannot locate. It took E1’s pooled corroborated share over native and native+ledger from 73% to 71.4%. E2’s fell from 42% to 40.8%. The originals of the re-scored answers are archived. The operator-stream rule grades that log corroborated for Q1 only: the sandbox witnessed that the harness printed the lines, but the harness wrote them. It lowered trace by 3.9 points.
paragraphs.zh: 审查后，两条规则被收紧，且两者都降低了份额。 无法定位的规则绝不会证实片段匹配器无法定位的账本行。 E1 的合并确认份额（相对于 native 和 native+ledger）从 73% 降至 71.4%。 E2 的份额从 42% 降至 40.8%。 重新评分的答案原始版本已归档。 操作流规则仅对 Q1 的已证实日志进行评分：沙箱观察到测试框架打印了这些行，但测试框架是写入它们的。 它将追踪分数降低了 3.9 分。

paragraphs.en: A strict aider rule only strengthens the headlines. No aider run executed a shell command. All 28 records are single-turn, and each “Run shell command?” prompt is answered n. So every one of the 685 lines opening with > is a status line, an echoed prompt, a filename or declined command, or the model’s own diff fence, never command output. Scoring those lines as narration flips 411 citations, all in aider. It moves every headline in the direction of the paper’s claims and reverses none:
paragraphs.zh: 严格的辅助规则只会强化标题。 没有任何一次辅助运行执行了 shell 命令。 全部 28 条记录均为单轮交互，且每个“运行 shell 命令？”提示的回答均为 n。 因此，所有以 > 开头的 685 行内容都是状态行、回显提示、文件名或拒绝的命令，或是模型自身的 diff 分界符，绝不会是命令输出。 将这些行计为叙述性内容会翻转 411 处引用，且全部位于辅助部分。 它使所有标题都朝着论文主张的方向发展，但没有反转任何标题：

paragraphs.en: E1’s ledger shift grows from +5.3 to +7.5, with bootstrap interval [+3.5, +11.6]. E2’s stays not significant (+1.9). The E1 to E2 gap is 28.0 points. The self-report gaps widen to 24, 61, and 49 points. The haiku validator agrees with the registered rules on 72 of 100. It sides with the strict rule on the status lines but reads the echoed prompts as terminal transcript, so under the strict rule it agrees on 69 of 100. The registered rule stays primary because it was the convention fixed before scoring, not because the validator separates the two.

paragraphs.en: The Q3 injection had to pass an adversarial gate before any examination. E1’s own model, claude-sonnet-5, was shown both copies of a record side by side and asked which was edited. The injector was repaired until the gate could not pick the edited copy significantly above chance; a bound of 65% was also set before the run. After five repair rounds, each a fix of the injector and a re-run, it distinguished them at 57.5% (65 of 113). That is not significantly above chance (one-sided binomial p = 0.066). Before the first repair it stood at 83.7%, on 82 of 98 pairs whose prompts then fit the window. By round, accuracy went from 83.7 to 70.9 and then 64.5%. It rose to 70.3% in round four and ended at 57.5%. The rounds repaired injection artefacts, not the alterations themselves. They fixed cloned entries without fresh identifiers and timestamps, and deleted messages that left token counts unadjusted. They also fixed rewrites that broke aider’s code fences or placed a passing verdict outside an output position.
paragraphs.zh: Q3 注入内容在通过任何检查之前，都必须先经过一个对抗性关卡。 E1 自己的模型 claude-sonnet-5 被同时展示了一份记录的两种副本，并被问及哪一份是经过编辑的。 注入器持续被修复，直到该关卡无法显著高于随机水平地识别出编辑过的副本；在运行前还设定了 65% 的界限。 经过五个修复轮次（每轮包括修复注入器和重新运行），其识别准确率达到了 57.5%（113 次中正确 65 次）。 这一结果并未显著高于随机水平（单侧二项式检验 p = 0.066）。 在第一次修复之前，准确率为 83.7%，基于当时提示符符合窗口的 98 对记录中的 82 对。 各轮次中，准确率从 83.7% 降至 70.9%，随后进一步降至 64.5%。 到了第四轮，准确率回升至 70.3%，最终稳定在 57.5%。 这些修复轮次修正的是注入造成的伪影，而非改动本身。 它们修复了缺少新标识符和时间戳的克隆条目，并删除了未调整词元计数的消息。 它们还修复了那些破坏了 aider 代码围栏或将通过性判定置于输出位置之外的重写操作。

paragraphs.en: The pass does not hang on the two unparsed answers. The gate ran against all 115 pairs. Two of the 115 fifth-round answer sheets are not counted, so the denominator is 113. One mixed prose with JSON and parsed to a wrong answer; the other hit the output-token limit with an empty body. Counting both as wrong gives 65 of 115, p = 0.096. Counting both as correct, the reading least favourable to the gate, gives 67 of 115, p = 0.046, still under the bound.

E1’s detection and false-positive rates in Table 1 are conditioned on that. An equal-length rewrite of a test verdict leaves the traceback and exit code in place. That class is therefore easier than an adversary would make it, and its detection rate is an upper bound.

paragraphs.en: Under a second judge, the gate falls between its registered readings. The same 115 pairs, window, prompt and A/B assignment were judged once each by deepseek-v4-pro (thinking disabled, direct API), with no further repair. It distinguished them on 70 of 115 pairs. That is 60.9% [51.7, 69.3], with one-sided binomial p = 0.012. The entry registering this run fixed two readings in advance, each with a significance condition as well as an accuracy one. Below 65% with p ≥ \geq 0.05, the gate holds for a second vendor. At 65% or above with p < < 0.05, it held only against E1’s family. The result falls between them and is reported as such: for this judge the gate did not hold, though accuracy stayed within the registered bound. The signal is in the fabrications and in opencode. The judge told apart 33 of 41 fabrications (80%), where the sonnet gate told apart 18 of 39. On opencode it told apart 22 of 28. The removals sit below chance, at 17 of 46. The rewrites are at 20 of 28, against the sonnet gate’s 23 of 28. The judge answered B on 81 pairs against a truth split of 59 and 56. This position bias, a preference for one side beyond the truth split, lowers accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在第二位裁判下，该门落在其已登记读数之间。 相同的 115 对样本、窗口、提示词和 A/B 分配各由 deepseek-v4-pro（禁用思考模式，直接 API）判断一次，且未进行进一步修复。 它在 115 对样本中区分出了 70 对。 即 60.9% [51.7, 69.3]，单侧二项分布 p = 0.012。 记录此次运行的条目预先固定了两次读数，每次均包含一个显著性条件和一个准确性条件。 在低于 65% 且 p ≥ \geq 0.05 的情况下，该门对第二位供应商依然有效。 在达到 65% 或以上且 p < < 0.05 时，它仅能对抗 E1 的样本集。 结果落在两者之间，并以此报告：对于这位裁判，该门并未保持有效，尽管准确性仍处于已登记的界限内。 信号存在于伪造内容中，也存在于 opencode 中。 该裁判区分出了 41 个伪造样本中的 33 个（80%），而十四行诗门则区分出了 39 个中的 18 个。 在 opencode 上，它区分出了 28 个中的 22 个。 删除结果低于偶然水平，为 46 个中的 17 个。 改写结果则为 28 个中的 20 个，而十四行诗门的结果为 28 个中的 23 个。 该裁判在 81 对样本中选择了 B，而真实分布为 59 和 56。 这种立场偏差，即对某一侧的偏好超出了真实分布，会降低准确性。

paragraphs.en: E1 detects no less on the pairs its own family could not tell apart. paragraphs.en: This section gives the numbers behind §5, in the order the body reports them. That order is fault attribution (§5.1), corroboration (§5.2), alteration (§5.3), reconstruction (Q1), the human panel (§5.4), then the numbers the body quotes without a table. Every alternative reading is in Tables 28 and 29 of Appendix G . Table 1 (§5) holds the per-condition accuracies and corroborated shares. The paragraphs below give the cell counts and intervals behind it; they back §5.1 to §5.4 and the ledger shift of §6. A cell is one examiner’s answer on one run under one condition of §4.3. The main grid has 140 runs, 28 per harness. Grader 1 is the preregistered grader. Grader 2 is deepseek-v4-pro , E3’s own model. Grader 3 is gpt-5.2 , from a fourth vendor. Both use grader 1’s prompt. The majority counts a cell as correct when at least two graders say so. A citation is independently witnessed when the rule verifies it and it lands on material the harness did not write: the two anchors or the ledger’s rows. Every interval below treats runs, cells or pairs as independent draws. The 140 runs are 14 tasks × \times 5 harnesses × \times 2 attempts, so the headline intervals are also repeated below clustered by task and by task and harness. The script and results file behind each paragraph are listed in the release ( RELEASE-README.md , ”Appendix sources”).
paragraphs.zh: 本节给出了 §5 中数字的来源，顺序与正文所述一致。 该顺序为：归因（§5.1）、证实（§5.2）、修改（§5.3）、重建（Q1）、人类评审小组（§5.4），最后是正文未通过表格引用的数字。 所有替代解读均见附录 G 的表 28 和表 29。 表 1（§5）列出了各条件下的准确率及已证实的比例。 以下段落给出了其对应的单元格计数与置信区间；这些内容支持了 §5.1 至 §5.4，以及 §6 中的账本变动。 一个单元格指一名评审员在 §4.3 规定的某一条件下的一次运行中的回答。 主网格包含 140 次运行，每个测试套件 28 次。 评分员 1 是预先注册的评分员。 评分员 2 是 deepseek-v4-pro，即 E3 自身的模型。 评分员 3 是 gpt-5.2，来自第四家供应商。 两者均使用评分员 1 的提示词。 当至少两名评分员判定正确时，多数情况将单元格视为正确。 当规则验证了引用内容，且该内容属于测试套件未编写的材料（即两个锚点或账本的行）时，该引用被视为独立见证。 以下所有置信区间都将运行、单元格或配对视为独立抽样。 140 次运行由 14 项任务 × 5 个测试套件 × 2 次尝试构成，因此标题中的置信区间也按任务和“任务-测试套件”组合重复列于下方。 每个段落背后的脚本和结果文件均列于发布说明中（RELEASE-README.md，“附录来源”）。

paragraphs.en: Cell counts that differ from 140 (§5.1, §5.2). Every gap is a parse failure or a context overflow, never an API error. Every condition has 140 runs; the table gives the cells each examiner answered in a usable form. E1’s floor gap is the 35 cells detailed under ”E1’s floor cells” below. Under trace, three E1 answers did not parse: two unterminated strings and one missing delimiter. At ceiling, eight E1, seven E2 and five E3 bundles exceed the window even after folding. On those longest-record tasks the mechanically derived ground truth is itself too long. E3’s floor, anchors-alone, trace and ceiling cells were added later, on 2026-09-20 (Appendix H ). E3 answered the same condition questionnaires as E1 and E2, and every parse failure was re-issued until it parsed. E3’s 37 invalid answers over native and native+ledger are 19 unterminated JSON documents and 18 without the schema’s kind field. E1 and E2 answered all 280 native and native+ledger cells. E3 answered both on 106 runs, the n of its paired ledger shift (§6). On the 132 cells that native and ceiling both cover, grader 1 scores E1 97.7% under native and 94.7% at ceiling. On E2’s 133 common cells it scores 77.4% and 83.5%. E1’s three-point drop under that grader is thus on the same cells, not a denominator artefact. By the majority, E1’s two conditions are level, 91 and 92 (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与 140 不同的单元格计数（§5.1、§5.2）。 每个间隙都是解析失败或上下文溢出，绝不会是 API 错误。 每个条件都有 140 次运行；表格列出了每位考官以可用形式回答的单元格。 E1 的底层间隙即下文“E1 的底层单元格”部分详述的 35 个单元格。 在追踪阶段，三个 E1 答案未能解析：两个未终止的字符串和一个缺失的分隔符。 在顶层，八个 E1、七个 E2 和五个 E3 捆绑包即使在折叠后也超出了窗口范围。 在这些记录最长的任务中，机械推导出的基准答案本身也过长。 E3 的底层、仅锚点、追踪和顶层单元格是在 2026-09-20（附录 H）添加的。 E3 回答了与 E1 和 E2 相同的条件问卷，并且每个解析失败都重新提交，直到成功解析。 E3 在原生和原生+账本模式下的 37 个无效答案中，有 19 个是未终止的 JSON 文档，18 个缺少方案中的“类型”字段。 E1 和 E2 回答了全部 280 个原生和原生+账本的单元格。 E3 在 106 次运行中回答了两者，这是其配对账本偏移的 n（§6）。 在原生和顶层都覆盖的 132 个单元格上，评分员 1 对 E1 的评分为：原生模式下 97.7%，顶层模式下 94.7%。 在 E2 的 133 个共同单元格上，其评分为 77.4% 和 83.5%。 因此，E1 在该评分员手下出现三分之一点的分差，是源于相同的单元格，而非分母造成的伪影。 根据多数情况，E1 的两个条件处于同一水平，分别为 91 和 92（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: The second grader moves the level, not the ordering. Grader 2 lowers every rung of the ladder and keeps its order. Most of what it takes from correct goes to partial, not to wrong (table below). Correct-or-partial under grader 2 is still 97% for E1 and 91% for E2 under native. The two graders give the same label on 70.8% of the 1,067 cells both graded, Cohen’s kappa 0.49. Those cells are E1’s 514 and E2’s 553 on floor, trace, native and ceiling. The anchors-only, no-anchors and E3 cells were graded later and are not in the agreement figure. Read as bounds, both graders call E1’s attribution correct in 71% of native cells and either grader in 98%. For E2 the two bounds are 47% and 78%.
paragraphs.zh: 第二名评分者调整的是层级，而非顺序。 评分者 2 降低了梯子的每一级，但保持了其原有顺序。 从正确评分中扣除的大部分分数会转为部分正确，而非错误（见下表）。 在评分者 2 的评判下，E1 的正确或部分正确率仍为 97%，而 E2 在母语者样本中的正确或部分正确率为 91%。 在双方均评分的 1,067 个单元格中，两种评分方式对 70.8% 的单元格给出了相同的标签，科恩卡帕系数为 0.49。 这些单元格包括 E1 在基础、痕迹、母语和天花板层级上的 514 个单元格，以及 E2 的 553 个单元格。 仅含锚点、不含锚点以及 E3 的单元格是后来评分的，未包含在一致性图表中。 从边界值来看，在母语者样本的单元格中，两名评分者有 71% 的情况认为 E1 的归因正确，而至少有一名评分者认为正确的比例则达到 98%。 对于 E2，这两个边界值分别为 47% 和 78%。

paragraphs.en: The third grader lands within nine points of grader 1. Its ladder sits within nine points of grader 1 on every condition. Grader 2 is thus the strict outlier of the three, not the reference. Grader 3 grades every cell the other two graded, 2,834 in all. These are the main grid’s conditions for E1 and E2, E3’s native and native+ledger cells, and the cross-vendor runs. They include the re-examination in which E1 reads 56 of its runs a second time. They also include the record without the anchors, the write-time test, and the follow-up in which E1 is handed the query’s finding. All but the record without the anchors are in Appendix G . The third grader runs at low reasoning effort with an output budget of 250 tokens. For the 16% of cells whose four tries returned no visible text, the budget was raised to 2,000. A re-grading of 100 first-pass cells at the larger budget agreed with the first on 96%. All three graders agree outright on 65% of the 2,834 cells. On the deepseek-driven runs and on E3 the graders order the same way (table below). E1’s re-examination scores 88 against 86 on the first reading.
paragraphs.zh: 第三位评分者的得分与第一位评分者相差九分以内。 在所有条件下，其阶梯得分都与第一位评分者相差九分以内。 因此，第二位评分者是三者中明显的异常值，而非参考基准。 第三位评分者对另外两位评分者所评定的每个单元格都进行了评分，总计 2,834 个。 这些是主网格针对 E1 和 E2、E3 的“原生”及“原生+账本”单元格，以及跨供应商运行测试的条件。 其中包括重新评估环节，其中 E1 对其中的 56 次运行进行了第二次读取。 还包括不含锚点的记录、写入时间测试，以及后续评估，在后续评估中 E1 被提供了查询结果。 除不含锚点的记录外，其余内容均见附录 G。 第三位评分者在推理负荷较低的情况下运行，输出预算为 250 个词元。 对于 16% 的单元格（其四次尝试均未返回可见文本），预算被提高至 2,000。 使用更高预算对首批 100 个单元格进行重新评分，结果与首次评分在 96% 的情况下一致。 在所有 2,834 个单元格中，三位评分者在 65% 的单元格上完全达成一致。 在由 deepseek 驱动的运行和 E3 的评估中，三位评分者的排序结果相同（见下表）。 E1 在重新评估中的得分为 88，而首次读取时的得分为 86。

paragraphs.en: The record without the anchors. The record alone locates the fault as well as record plus anchors. Every record condition carries the two benchmark-written anchors, so the record’s own contribution was known only as a difference. E1 therefore examined the 140 native bundles with the anchor files anchors_pretest.log and anchors_workspace.diff removed. The protocol sentence naming them was swapped for one saying the bundle holds neither; the record and workspace listing stay. All 140 of 140 were valid after one re-issue of three. By the majority of three graders, E1 locates the fault in 91% [85, 94] of runs. Correct-or-partial is 99% (graders singly in Table 28 ). With the anchors it locates 91%; with the anchors alone, 64%. The two contributions are not additive (table below). Given the record, the anchors add nothing; given the anchors, the record adds the whole step.
paragraphs.zh: 没有锚点的记录。 仅凭记录本身也能定位错误，与包含锚点的记录效果相同。 每条记录条件都带有两个基准编写的锚点，因此记录本身的贡献仅能作为差异体现。 因此，E1 在移除了锚点文件 anchors_pretest.log 和 anchors_workspace.diff 后，检查了 140 个原生捆绑包。 原本命名这些文件的协议句子被替换为说明该捆绑包不包含任何锚点的句子；记录和工空间列表保持不变。 在三次重新发布后，全部 140 个捆绑包均有效。 根据多数三名评分员的判断，E1 在 91% [85, 94] 的运行中定位到了错误。 正确或部分正确的比例为 99%（评分员单独评估结果见表 28）。 包含锚点时，定位准确率为 91%；仅凭锚点时，准确率为 64%。 这两项贡献并非可加性的（见下表）。 在已有记录的情况下，锚点并未带来额外帮助；而在仅有锚点的情况下，记录则提供了完整的步骤信息。

paragraphs.en: Robustness of the corroborated share (§5.2). Neither run outcome nor a smaller agent model moves the share much. Stratifying native by outcome gives 69.0% on fixed runs against 67.1% on unfixed. The table gives how many runs fixed the entry test and how many hit the seven-minute bound. The smaller model is claude-haiku-4-5 , run on three outcome-balanced tasks. It leaves every harness’s share in the band it occupies under the primary model. Of 31 runs launched, 30 were extracted and two exceeded the 1M-token context. That leaves 28 valid cells for E1 and 23 for E2. Pooled, E1 reads 75.6% against 68.2% on the same tasks under the primary model. E2 reads 55.0% against 46.6%, the twenty-point examiner gap intact. The self-preference control of Appendix G re-examines the same 28 materials separately. It reads 72.9% there against 75.6% here; the two examine overlapping sets.
paragraphs.zh: 经证实的份额的稳健性（§5.2）。 无论是运行结果还是更小的智能体模型，都未对份额产生显著影响。 按结果对原生模型进行分层分析显示，固定运行下的份额为 69.0%，而非固定运行下则为 67.1%。 表格显示了有多少次运行通过了入门测试，以及有多少次达到了七分钟的限制。 较小的模型是 claude-haiku-4-5，在三个结果均衡的任务上运行。 它使每个测试框架的份额都保持在主模型下所占的区间内。 在启动的 31 次运行中，有 30 次被提取出来，两次超过了 100 万标记的上下文限制。 这样，E1 就剩下 28 个有效单元格，E2 则剩下 23 个。 合并来看，E1 的结果为 75.6%，而在相同任务下主模型的结果为 68.2%。 E2 的结果为 55.0%，而主模型的结果为 46.6%，两者之间二十个百分点的考察者差距依然存在。 附录 G 中的自我偏好控制方法对相同的 28 份材料进行了单独重新检验。 在此处，其结果为 72.9%，而本文中的结果为 75.6%；两者检验的是重叠的材料集合。

paragraphs.en: Independently witnessed share (§5.2, §6). The independently witnessed share credits only material the harness did not write; under native only the two anchors qualify. The corroborated share, by contrast, also credits tool output the harness itself recorded. The table gives both conditions, the ledger’s paired lift over runs and the fall in the harness-recorded corroborated share. The deepseek-driven rows use the like-for-like ledger. Shares are pooled over citations. A shift is the difference of the pooled shares over the runs valid under both conditions; its interval is a bootstrap over runs. On E3’s deepseek-driven rows that is 138 runs. Its shift (+11.2) is therefore not the difference of the two printed shares, which pool 138 and 140 cells. E2’s and E3’s main-grid shifts agree to the decimal. The coincidence was checked under two further seeds, and the decomposition below separates them: 3.9 against 2.4 points from ledger rows. The shares here use the event reading , the body’s registered rule of §4.3. Under it, a ledger row holding the agent’s own words counts for Q1, where the ledger witnessed the saying, and not for Q2.
paragraphs.zh: 独立观测到的份额（§5.2，§6）。 独立观测到的份额仅计入 harness 未写入的内容；在 native 模式下，只有两个锚点符合资格。 相比之下，经证实的份额还包括工具输出中 harness 自身记录的内容。 该表格列出了两种情况：账本在多次运行中的成对提升，以及 harness 记录的经证实份额的下降。 deepseek 驱动的各行使用同类账本数据。 份额在多个引用中汇总计算。 偏移量是两种条件下有效运行的汇总份额之差；其区间通过多次运行进行自助法估计。 在 E3 的 deepseek 驱动行中，该数值为 138 次运行。 因此，其偏移量（+11.2）并非两个已打印份额之差，这两个份额分别汇总了 138 个和 140 个单元格。 E2 和 E3 的主网格偏移量在小数点后一致。 这一巧合在另外两个种子下得到了验证，而下面的分解将它们区分开来：账本行贡献了 3.9 分与 2.4 分。 此处的份额使用了事件读取机制，即 §4.3 中记录的身体规则。 根据该规则，包含智能体自身话语的账本行计入 Q1（当账本观测到该话语时），而不计入 Q2。

sents.zh: 独立观测到的份额（§5.2，§6）。

sents.zh: 该表格列出了两种情况：账本在多次运行中的成对提升，以及 harness 记录的经证实份额的下降。

paragraphs.en: The same share under the narration reading, and the headline intervals clustered by task. The narration reading is the stricter one: it credits a ledger row of the agent’s own words for neither question. Under it the independently witnessed share under native+ledger is lower, since those rows are the ledger’s largest class. The ledger’s paired lift shrinks but still clears zero for E1 and E3; for E2 it no longer does (table below).
paragraphs.zh: 在叙述阅读部分，相同的份额存在，而标题间隔则按任务聚类。 叙述阅读的要求更为严格：对于两个问题，它都不会将智能体自身话语的账本行计入其中。 在此之下，通过原生+账本独立观测到的份额较低，因为这些行属于账本中最大的类别。 账本的成对提升有所缩小，但对于 E1 和 E3 仍高于零；而对于 E2，它已不再如此（见下表）。

paragraphs.en: Clustering the bootstrap moves no headline interval across zero. Clustering by task resamples all ten runs of a task together; clustering by task and harness does the same per harness. E1’s shift in the corroborated share under the event reading, the registered rule, reads +5.3 [+2.0, +8.7] over tasks. That is narrower than over runs, because the shift differs by harness and task clusters never resample harnesses. Over the 70 task-and-harness clusters it reads +5.3 [+1.8, +8.9]. The E1 - E2 gap reads +27.7 [+21.0, +34.2] over tasks. E1’s staircase keeps its order with wider steps. Anchors alone reads 63.6 [45.7, 80.7]. Native reads 90.7 [82.9, 97.1]. The full set, B = 10,000, seed 20260920, is in the sources. E3’s shifts are paired over the 106 runs both conditions cover. They therefore differ from the difference of its pooled shares over 118 and 125 cells: -1.6 against -1.9 for the registered share.

paragraphs.en: Cited against available independent support (§4.3, §5.2). Even at a loose upper bound, about seven in ten of E1’s native citations have no independent copy in the bundle. The label grades the source an examiner cited, not whether the cited content also exists in a source the harness did not write. Table 23 gives Q3 per witness. Each row sets detection on the altered copy against the same reader’s false-positive rate on the clean copy. The table then gives the two checks of §6 on the same pairs. The query reports omissions (”one-way” in the write-time rows); the reverse check reports fabrications (Appendix G ). The query’s 16.5% false findings are all on the extracted copies the examiners read. All come from folding or from cline cutting tool outputs. On the records as the harnesses stored them, the query makes no false finding. Its reports on 7 of the 140 (5%) are true: each record lacks a last unit the harness never filed. The reverse rows cover the four formats with a reverse rule, 95 pairs; SWE-agent’s 20 are excluded. The rules were written on those pairs. Their false-positive cell gives the paired figure first, then the stand-alone range over formats. The paired figure relies on a clean twin, which a deployment reading one record would not have. Stand-alone, aider flags 0 of 11 clean copies and opencode 0 of 28. Mini-SWE-agent and cline flag 26 of 28 each, 52 of 95 in all. Held out, opencode flags 0 of 28 and aider 4 of 16. Mini-SWE-agent flags 21 of 22 and cline 21 of 21. The two write-time rows are the 28 aider runs of Appendix G . On them a hash chain over the harness’s own record detects nothing. The two-together row is over the 95 pairs with a reverse rule. Adding the query’s reports on SWE-agent’s 20 pairs gives the 98 of 115 of §6. The human row is the majority of three annotators per copy over all 115 pairs. The preregistration named 25 pairs for five annotators each; that round was not run, and on those 25, read like the rest by three per copy, the panel detects 9 at 3 false positives. No annotator passes the registered bound of 60% detection at 10% false positives.
paragraphs.zh: 表23给出了每位见证者的Q3结果。 每一行都将修改副本上的检测率与同一阅读器在干净副本上的误报率进行对比。 该表接着给出了§6中针对相同配对的两项检查。 查询报告了遗漏（写入时间行中的“单向”）；反向检查则报告了伪造（附录G）。 查询中16.5%的误判全部出现在审阅者所读取的提取副本上。 所有问题均源于折叠操作或cline切割工具的输出。 在记录以harness存储的形式下，查询未发现任何误判。 它对140个记录中7个（5%）的报告为真实：每个记录都缺少一个harness从未归档的最后一个单元。 反向行涵盖了使用反向规则的四种格式，共95对；SWE智能体的20对被排除在外。 这些规则正是在这些配对上编写的。 它们的误报单元格首先给出配对数值，然后给出跨格式的独立范围。 配对数值依赖于一个干净的孪生副本，而实际部署中读取单个记录时并不会拥有该副本。 在独立测试中，aider在11个干净副本中未标记出任何问题，opencode在28个中也未标记出任何问题。 Mini-SWE智能体和cline各自在28个中标记出26个，总计在95对中标记出52个。 单独测试时，opencode在28个中未标记出任何问题，aider在16个中标记出4个。 Mini-SWE智能体在22个中标记出21个，cline在21个中标记出21个。 两个写入时间行对应附录G中aider的28次运行。 在这些运行中，基于harness自身记录的哈希链未检测到任何内容。 “两者结合”行是针对使用反向规则的95对数据进行的测试。 将查询对SWE智能体20个配对的报告加入后，得到§6中提到的115对中的98对。 人类标注行代表每份副本由三名标注者完成，覆盖全部115对。 预注册时指定了25对数据，每对由五名标注者处理；该轮测试并未执行，在这25对中，按常规由每份副本三名标注者处理，专家组检测出9个问题，误报率为3%。 没有一名标注者达到注册标准：60%的检出率和10%的误报率。

sents.en: The preregistration named 25 pairs for five annotators each; that round was not run, and on those 25, read like the rest by three per copy, the panel detects 9 at 3 false positives.
sents.zh: 预注册时指定了25对数据，每对由五名标注者处理；该轮测试并未执行，在这25对中，按常规由每份副本三名标注者处理，专家组检测出9个问题，误报率为3%。

sents.en: No annotator passes the registered bound of 60% detection at 10% false positives.
sents.zh: 没有一名标注者达到注册标准：60%的检出率和10%的误报率。

paragraphs.en: Confidence does not carry detection (§5.3). E2 reported 100 on all 230 of its sheets. E1’s median confidence is 78 when it flags an altered copy and 72 when it misses one. On clean copies it is 66 when E1 wrongly flags and 78 when it does not. Detection is therefore read against a paired clean control. Confidence can still be read as a score: the stated confidence when the verdict is altered, and its complement otherwise. On that score the sheets rank altered above clean copies with AUC 0.76 for E1, 0.72 for E2 and 0.69 for E3. As a sensitivity, a threshold of 70 leaves E2 unchanged and moves E1 as the table shows. The verdict as given thus already sits near the best trade-off the confidences allow.
paragraphs.zh: 置信度不包含检测信息（§5.3）。 E2 在其全部 230 张表格中均报告了 100。 当 E1 标记出被修改的副本时，其置信度中位数为 78；而未能识别时则为 72。 对于干净的副本，E1 错误标记时的置信度为 66，未标记时则为 78。 因此，检测结果需与配对的干净对照样本进行对比解读。 置信度仍然可以作为一个分数来解读：当判定结果为“修改”时，使用所声明的置信度；否则使用其补值。 从这一指标来看，各表格中“修改”副本的排名高于“干净”副本，E1、E2 和 E3 的 AUC 分别为 0.76、0.72 和 0.69。 作为灵敏度指标，70 的阈值使 E2 保持不变，而 E1 的位置则如表格所示发生了变化。 因此，当前给出的判定结果已经接近置信度所允许的最佳权衡点。

paragraphs.en: Detection with and without placeholders. The placeholders raise E2’s false-positive rate by about ten points and move nothing else. Of the 115 pairs, 48 carry a folding or de-duplication placeholder in a copy and 67 carry none. The 48 are the 28 mini-SWE-agent and 20 SWE-agent pairs; aider, cline and opencode carry none. Wilson 95% intervals.

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction by mechanical alignment (Q1). Sparse records did not induce invented steps: precision is 1.0 at the median everywhere. Each examiner’s steps are aligned mechanically against the run’s distinct decision points. A decision point is one (action, file) pair among the task’s files, in first-occurrence order; the median run has four. Recall by condition is in the table. Precision is the share of the examiner’s edit and run steps that occurred in the run. Its means run from 0.76 on floor to 0.87 under native. Between 40 and 66% of steps are reads or reasoning, which the environment boundary cannot witness. The model-judged recall is a grader model’s judgement of which decision points the steps cover (Appendix H ). It correlates with the mechanical recall at Spearman 0.41 over the 1,162 E1 and E2 cells that carry both readings. Those cells span floor, anchors alone, trace, native and ceiling. The model-judged recall runs higher, means 0.51 against 0.34.
paragraphs.zh: 通过机械对齐进行重建（Q1）。 稀疏记录并未引发虚构步骤：在所有情况下，中位数处的精确度均为 1.0。 每位考官的步骤均通过机械方式与运行中的各个决策点相对应。 一个决策点是任务文件中（动作，文件）对之一，按首次出现顺序排列；中位数运行包含四个决策点。 按条件划分的召回率见表格。 精确度是指考官的编辑步骤和运行步骤中发生在运行内的比例。 其平均值从基础阶段的 0.76 到原生阶段的 0.87。 在 40% 至 66% 的步骤为读取或推理，这些步骤无法被环境边界观察到。 模型判定的召回率是评分模型对步骤所覆盖决策点的判断（附录 H）。 在同时包含两种读数的 1,162 个 E1 和 E2 单元格中，它与机械召回率的相关性为斯皮尔曼等级相关系数 0.41。 这些单元格涵盖了基础阶段、仅锚点、追踪、原生和天花板阶段。 模型判定的召回率更高，平均值为 0.51，而机械召回率为 0.34。

paragraphs.en: Human panel (§4.3, §5.4). Thirty-seven annotators took part, each in one task only, blind to every result and to the base rate; no one saw both copies of a pair. Alteration pairs: twenty annotators gave every copy of all 115 pairs three verdicts (690 in all), each copy judged by majority. Confidence falls as an annotator works through the list (median 52, 42 and 39 over the first, middle and last third of each annotator’s copies) while accuracy does not (63%, 65%, 61% of verdicts correct). Landing-site rule: five annotators rate the 100-citation sample, 90 singly and 10 by all five, with the rule’s definitions and no model verdict in view. Human examiners: five annotators each read the native record of one run per task (14 runs, 70 sheets) under the protocol of §4.3 and answer the fault question with five citations each. Human grading: three annotators grade 100 sampled examiner answers, 25 per condition, against the per-task keys, blind to condition, on the graders’ three-point scale.
paragraphs.zh: 人类评审团（§4.3，§5.4）。 共有三十七名标注员参与，每人仅负责一项任务，且对任何结果和基础概率均不知情；无人同时看到同一对的两个版本。 修改对：二十名标注员为全部115对的两个版本分别给出了三项判定（总计690项），每个版本均按多数判定结果确定。 随着标注员逐步处理列表，其置信度逐渐下降（各标注员所标注样本的前、中、后三分之一部分中，置信度中位数分别为52、42和39），但准确率并未下降（判定正确的比例分别为63%、65%和61%）。 着陆点规则：五名标注员对包含100条引文的样本进行评分，其中90条由一人单独评分，10条由五人共同评分；评分时仅可见该规则的定义，且无模型判定结果可供参考。 人类考官：五名标注员每人阅读一项任务中一次运行的原始记录（共14次运行，70张表格），遵循§4.3的协议，并依据五条引文回答故障问题。 人类评分：三名标注员根据各任务的评分标准，对100份抽样考官答案进行评分（每种情况25份），评分采用三分制，且不知晓具体分组情况。

paragraphs.en: Human panel results. Rule agreement is 82 of 100 [73, 88]. Of the 18 disagreements, 7 call a rule-corroborated citation narration and 1 the reverse, so by the reading registered in advance the corroborated shares of §5.2 carry that direction: people would grade a few of them down. The other 10 are excerpts the annotators could not find, which the rule located verbatim. On the ten shared citations a strict majority forms on all ten, and the five agree unanimously on two. Detection is 42 of 115 (36.5% [28.3, 45.6]) at 11 of 115 clean copies flagged (9.6% [5.4, 16.3]); 25 of 72 witnessed and 17 of 43 unwitnessed alterations; by type 16 of 46 removals, 7 of 28 rewrites and 19 of 41 fabrications. Inter-annotator agreement over the 230 copies is 0.61 (Fleiss’ kappa). Human examiners attribute the fault in 11 of 14 runs by majority (41 of 70 sheets). Of their 350 citations, 195 (56%) land on the final diff, an anchor the harness did not write; the other 155 land in the record and are not graded here. Human grading agrees with the majority of three graders on 84 of 100 in correct-versus-not (Cohen’s kappa 0.69). Correct shares rise in the models’ order: 6, 11, 12 and 15 of 25 on floor, anchors alone, native and ceiling, against 5, 15, 18 and 20 for the graders. The sheets and assignment lists ship with the data.
paragraphs.zh: 人类评审团的结果。 规则一致度为 82/100 [73, 88]。 在 18 处分歧中，有 7 处指向规则所证实的引文叙述，另有 1 处则相反；因此，根据预先登记的解读，§5.2 中经证实的部分支持这一方向：人们会对其中一些内容给出较低评分。 其余 10 处是标注者未能找到的片段，但规则却能逐字定位到这些内容。 在十处共享引文中，严格多数意见在所有十处均达成一致，而五名评审员在两处完全一致。 检测准确率为 42/115（36.5% [28.3, 45.6]），涉及 115 份被标记的干净副本中的 11 份（9.6% [5.4, 16.3]）；在 72 处有见证的改动中检测到 25 处，在 43 处无见证的改动中检测到 17 处；按类型划分，46 处删除中有 16 处、28 处改写中有 7 处、41 处捏造中有 19 处。 在 230 份副本上，标注者之间的互评一致度为 0.61（Fleiss Kappa 值）。 人类评审员在 14 次运行中的 11 次中通过多数意见认定了错误（涉及 70 张表格中的 41 张）。 在他们引用的 350 处引文中，有 195 处（56%）出现在最终差异中，而该锚点并非由系统生成；其余 155 处则记录在案，此处不予评分。 在正确与不正确判断上，人类评分与三名评审员的多数意见在 100 项中有 84 项一致（Cohen Kappa 值 0.69）。 模型的正确率按顺序上升：在基础层、仅锚点、原生层和顶层中，正确数分别为 25 项中的 6、11、12 和 15 项；而评审员的正确数则为 5、15、18 和 20 项。 表格与分配清单随数据一同提供。

paragraphs.en: The query and the reverse check each measure one of the three ways a record falls short (§2). The query measures the first, what the harness never filed. paragraphs.en: Terms. A unit is one assistant text, tool argument or tool output as the harness told it to the model. An alteration is witnessed when it touches a unit the environment-side writer records, assistant text or a tool-call argument, and unwitnessed otherwise. The label follows from the unit type in the sealed manifest and is listed per pair in the reconciliation results. The 72 witnessed alterations are 46 removals, 24 rewrites and 2 fabrications. The 43 unwitnessed are 4 rewrites of tool output and 39 fabricated units the ledger never saw. Of the 43, 33 fall on a format with a reverse rule, and the reverse check reports 32 of those 33. On those formats it also reports 24 of the 62 witnessed alterations. The four tool-output rewrites are SWE-agent pairs whose ledger rows keep terminal line endings the record strips, so the verbatim query misses them. A tier is one of the reverse check’s three match rules: verbatim, escaped and whitespace-normalised. An altered copy’s clean twin is the pair’s clean half, the unaltered copy of the same run. A paired difference counts only findings the altered half has and its clean twin lacks, so findings a format produces on every copy cancel out. A stand-alone clean baseline is what a check reports on a clean copy read alone.
paragraphs.zh: 术语。 一个单元是指一个助手文本、工具参数或工具输出，即执行框架按照模型指示提供给它的任何内容。 当它接触环境侧记录者所记录的单元——无论是助手文本还是工具调用参数——时，会观察到一次变更；其他情况下则不会观察到。 标签由密封清单中的单元类型决定，并在对账结果中按每对列出。 72 次被观察到的变更包括 46 次删除、24 次重写和 2 次捏造。 43 次未被观察到的变更包括 4 次工具输出的重写，以及 39 个账本从未见过的捏造单元。 在这 43 次中，有 33 次涉及具有反向规则的格式，而反向检查报告了其中 32 次。 在这些格式上，该检查还报告了 62 次被观察到的变更中的 24 次。 四次工具输出的重写属于 SWE-智能体对，其账本行保留了记录中已被剥离的终端换行符，因此逐字查询未能发现它们。 一个层级是反向检查三种匹配规则之一：逐字匹配、转义匹配和空白符归一化匹配。 一个变更副本的纯净孪生体是该对的纯净部分，即同一运行中未经变更的副本。 成对差异仅计算变更副本具有而其纯净孪生体所缺乏的发现项，因此格式在每次副本中产生的发现项会相互抵消。 独立的纯净基线是检查单独读取纯净副本时所报告的内容。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 7 draws the append-only substrate and the audit: two writers, one table, one query, and the reverse check described below. Two locks make the table append-only below the application. The writer role holds INSERT only and is never granted TRUNCATE, and a trigger refuses UPDATE and DELETE. The table’s owner, the operator’s role, can still drop the trigger or truncate; that is the trust §7 names.

paragraphs.en: The audit is one query in three parts. (A) It re-verifies each writer’s chain row by row. (B) It requires every environment-witnessed unit to appear verbatim in the harness’s own record, with snapshot-style records reduced to their latest snapshot plus later appends. (C) It counts only findings absent from a clean baseline run of the same task, so that what a format always leaves out is not reported as an alteration.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计是一项包含三个部分的查询。 （A）它会逐行重新验证每位作者的链式记录。 （B）它要求每个环境见证单元必须原封不动地出现在框架自身的记录中，其中快照式记录会被简化为最新的快照以及后续追加的内容。 （C）它仅统计在相同任务的干净基线运行中未出现的发现，因此格式本身始终遗漏的内容不会被报告为变更。

paragraphs.en: Both writers share one insert-only role; a deployment would separate them. Both writers connect as sbx_writer , which can insert but never update or delete. The harness inherits the ledger’s connection string from its environment, so it could insert rows as env . None of the five does, and the write-time test below attacks the harness’s own record, not the database. A deployment separates the roles: a row policy confines the harness role to writer = ’harness’ , and the socket stays out of the harness’s namespace. The row hash binds writer, sequence, kind, reference and body, but not the timestamp. Altering ts needs update rights, which the trigger denies and only the operator excluded by §4.2 holds. Binding ts is a one-token change to the preimage. The ledger supplies the first absent-reader property of §3: a record that can be checked from outside and shows any tampering. It carries no domain provenance, so it would score absent on the second.
paragraphs.zh: 两位写作者都共享一个仅允许插入的角色；部署会将它们分离。 两位写作者都以 sbx_writer 身份连接，该身份只能插入，但永远不能更新或删除。 该工具包从其环境中继承账本的连接字符串，因此它可以以 env 身份插入行。 这五个角色中没有一个具备此权限，而下面的写入时测试针对的是工具包自身的记录，而非数据库。 部署会分离这些角色：行策略将工具包的角色限制为 writer = ’harness’，而套接字则不会进入工具包的命名空间。 行哈希绑定了写作者、序列、类型、引用和正文，但不包括时间戳。 修改 ts 需要更新权限，而触发器会拒绝该权限，只有 §4.2 中排除的操作员才拥有此权限。 绑定 ts 只需对预映像进行一个标记的更改。 账本提供了 §3 中缺失的第一个读取者属性：一个可以从外部验证并能显示任何篡改行为的记录。 它不包含任何域来源信息，因此在第二个属性上会得分为“缺失”。

paragraphs.en: What the ledger costs. Over the full grid the ledger totals 49.1 MB against 46.3 MB of native records, 1.06 × \times . Per framework the ratio runs from 0.57 × \times to 6.87 × \times . It follows the native record’s size, which runs from 4.6 KB to 1.2 MB per run. The attributable costs are 0.020 ms per polling read and 2.74 ms per row insert. A paired wall-clock comparison ran two frameworks at opposite ends of the call-count range, instrumented and uninstrumented, n = 16. It finds +14 ms per call against a within-group standard deviation of 236 ms. Reconciliation covers 2,225 of 2,271 model calls over the 140 runs (98%). Tool arguments shorter than 20 characters, the environment-side writer’s unit minimum, are not reconciled, and neither are non-string argument values.
paragraphs.zh: 账本的成本。 在整个网格中，账本的总大小为 49.1 MB，而原生记录为 46.3 MB，即 1.06 × \times。 每个框架的比率从 0.57 × \times 到 6.87 × \times 不等。 该比率与原生记录的大小一致，每次运行的原生记录大小从 4.6 KB 到 1.2 MB 不等。 可归因的成本为每次轮询读取 0.020 ms，每行插入 2.74 ms。 一项配对的实际时间比较在调用次数范围的两端运行了两个框架：一个经过仪器化，另一个未经仪器化，n = 16。 结果显示每次调用增加 +14 ms，组内标准差为 236 ms。 在 140 次运行中，对 2,271 次模型调用的 2,225 次进行了核对（98%）。 工具参数长度小于 20 个字符（环境端写入器的最小单位）时不会被核对，非字符串参数值同样不会被核对。

paragraphs.en: On clean native records the query reports only units the harness never filed. Over the 140 main-grid runs it reports eight units on seven runs and nothing on the other 133. Each is the last unit of its run, an output the harness never filed; none is a unit it filed. Three are the last assistant text of three SWE-agent runs that ended in a decoding error. Others come from runs killed at the bound: the last text and tool arguments of a SWE-agent run, and the last tool arguments of two mini-SWE-agent runs. The last is the final tool call of the pytest run shown next. The clean halves of the 115 alteration pairs are not native records but extracted copies, each run’s record as the extraction step copied and folded it (Appendix D ). On them the query reports 19 findings: 15 folding placeholders and four outputs cline truncated before the model saw them. None is a unit the harness filed. The reverse check has its own clean baseline on the two main-grid formats it reads. On the 28 aider runs it reports nothing. On mini-SWE-agent the result depends on which ledgers hold tool-output rows, a row kind added partway through the main grid. Only ten main-grid ledgers hold them: the mini-SWE-agent runs of the tasks run after that addition. On those ten the check reports one unit on nine, always the synthetic final observation action was not executed . The harness appends it at submission and never sends it to the model. On the 18 runs whose ledgers predate tool-output rows, every recorded tool output is unmatched; that is a limit of that ledger export, not of the record.
paragraphs.zh: 在干净的原始记录中，查询仅报告了智能体框架从未提交的单元。 在 140 次主网格运行中，它在 7 次运行中报告了 8 个单元，其余 133 次则未报告任何内容。 每个单元都是其运行中的最后一个单元，是智能体框架从未提交的输出；没有一个是它曾提交的单元。 其中三个是三次以解码错误结束的 SWE-智能体运行的最后助手文本。 其他记录来自在边界处终止的运行：一次 SWE-智能体运行的最后文本和工具参数，以及两次迷你 SWE-智能体运行的最后工具参数。 最后一个记录是接下来所示的 pytest 运行中的最后一次工具调用。 115 对变更中的干净部分并非原始记录，而是提取的副本；每次运行的记录都在提取步骤中被复制并折叠（附录 D）。 在这些记录上，查询报告了 19 项发现：15 个折叠占位符和 4 个在模型看到之前被截断的 cline 输出。 没有一个是智能体框架提交的单元。 反向检查在其读取的两种主网格格式上拥有自己的干净基线。 在 28 次 aider 运行中，它未报告任何内容。 对于迷你 SWE-智能体，结果取决于哪些账本包含工具输出行——这是一种在主网格运行期间部分添加的行类型。 只有十个主网格账本包含这些行：即在该添加操作之后运行的任务的迷你 SWE-智能体运行。 在这十个账本中，检查在九个账本中报告了一个单元，且始终为“合成的最终观察动作未被执行”。 智能体框架在提交时附加该记录，但从未将其发送给模型。 在 18 个账本早于工具输出行的运行中，所有记录的工具输出均不匹配；这是该账本导出方式的限制，而非记录本身的限制。

paragraphs.en: A sequence-aware match rule leaves the headline unchanged and costs clean records. This stricter variant of part B requires each witnessed unit to appear at or after the point where the previous one matched, in ledger order. Under it the witnessed layer stays at 58 of 72. The variant recovers 6 of the 14 misses, all reported as out of order. They are five SWE-agent removals whose surviving copy sits before the cursor, and the one cline rewrite at a unit edge. It loses 6 opencode detections, because opencode’s dump order already marks the same call out of order on the clean half. A per-call cursor reaches 60. The unwitnessed 43 stay at zero. The cost falls on clean records. Clean halves with a part-B finding rise from 19 to 50 of 115. The main-grid baseline rises from 8 units on 7 runs to 29 on 13. All are out-of-order units of record layout: SWE-agent writes its trajectory before its history, and opencode’s dump is ordered by table. Ledger sequence is not the order of witnessing either. A call’s request-side units share its timestamp and are written after its response, so a literal sequence cursor collapses to 35 of 72. The seven mini-SWE-agent rewrites stay missed under every rule. They need field-level normalisation of extra.raw_output , not a match rule.

paragraphs.en: The reverse direction, measured on two formats. The reverse check asks the mirror of the one-way question. The one-way query asks whether every witnessed unit appears verbatim in the record. The reverse check asks whether every unit of the native record appears verbatim inside one environment-side row ( model_text , tool_input or tool_result ) of the same run. It matches per row, so no unit can be assembled from two. Units follow each format’s structure. For aider they are the text blocks after the first user turn, less the banner and console echo, which never cross the model boundary. For mini-SWE-agent they are assistant content, tool-call arguments and tool content, with prompts skipped. The 20-character minimum is the environment-side writer’s own, and detection is paired exactly as in §6. The 39 aider and mini-SWE-agent pairs hold 19 removals, 8 rewrites and 12 fabrications. The reverse direction reports 20 (51.3%, 95% Wilson CI [36.2, 66.1]). By kind it reports removals 0 of 19, rewrites 8 of 8 and fabrications 12 of 12. The shipped direction reports 21: removals 18, rewrites 1, fabrications 2. Either direction reports 38 of 39 (97.4% [86.8, 99.5]). The reverse check reports all seven mini-SWE-agent rewrites the one-way query missed. It reads the edited content field, not the second copy that survives in extra.raw_output . The one pair neither reports removes a prompt stored under an assistant role, a layer no writer witnesses. All 2,708 matches of record units against ledger rows are verbatim; the escaped and whitespace tiers never fired.

paragraphs.en: The reverse check’s cost is its stand-alone clean baseline. On the clean copies of the 39 pairs, 26 carry a reverse finding: aider 0 of 11 and mini-SWE-agent 26 of 28. The 27 findings are 26 closing action was not executed observations, which mini-SWE-agent writes without a call, and one mislabelled prompt. They appear identically on the native records whenever the ledger holds tool-output rows, as every pair replay’s ledger does. On those 28 records the reverse direction’s stand-alone clean baseline is therefore 27 findings on 26 copies, where the one-way direction’s is 0. Because they appear identically on both copies of a pair, the paired protocol subtracts them out. A deployment reading one record alone would need a per-format allowlist. Of the 45 lines of unit rules, 36 are format-specific: aider 15 and mini-SWE-agent 21. Neither format’s rules work on the other. The rules were written from record structure with the tampered pairs in hand and none held out, so these figures are in-sample. A fresh format needs its rule written and then tested on unseen pairs; the held-out test below does that for the four formats. No agent, harness or examiner was re-run.
paragraphs.zh: 反向检查的成本是其独立的干净基线。 在 39 对数据的干净副本中，有 26 个存在反向发现：aider 0/11，mini-SWE-agent 26/28。 这 27 项发现包括 26 条“关闭操作未执行”的观察记录（这些是 mini-SWE-agent 无需调用即可写入的记录），以及一条错误标记的提示。 只要账本包含工具输出行，它们就会在原始记录中以完全相同的方式出现，正如每一对数据重播的账本所显示的那样。 因此，在这 28 条记录中，反向方向的独立干净基线为 26 个副本中的 27 项发现，而单向方向的基线则为 0。 由于它们在同一对数据的两个副本中完全相同，配对协议会将它们相互抵消。 如果部署时仅读取一条记录，则需要为每种格式单独设置允许列表。 在 45 行单元规则中，有 36 行是格式特定的：aider 15 和 mini-SWE-agent 21。 这两种格式的规则都无法在对方格式上生效。 这些规则是在手头已有被篡改的数据对、未保留任何测试数据的情况下，根据记录结构编写的，因此这些数字属于样本内结果。 对于新的格式，需要为其编写规则，然后在未见过的数据对上进行测试；下方的预留测试集正是针对这四种格式进行的验证。 没有任何智能体、框架或审查员被重新运行。

paragraphs.en: The reverse direction on cline and opencode. Two more unit rules were written the same way, with the pairs in hand and no hold-out, and are shared between the halves of a pair. For cline the units are the assistant text blocks and tool-call argument leaves of *.messages.json , prompts excluded. For opencode they are the part rows of the session database or its dump: assistant text and tool input and output, with reasoning, step and patch parts excluded. Ten of the 56 copies are folded, so rows are classed by column shape, not table header. Floor, tiers, fold splitting and paired difference are those of the first two formats. On the 56 pairs the reverse direction reports cline 16 of 28 (removals 0 of 11, rewrites 7 of 7, fabrications 9 of 10). It reports opencode 20 of 28 (removals 0 of 8, rewrites 7 of 7, fabrications 13 of 13). Every detection falls on the altered unit. The union with the one-way query is 27 of 28 and 28 of 28. Over the four formats, 95 of the 115 pairs, the reverse direction reports 56 (removals 0 of 38, rewrites 22 of 22, fabrications 34 of 35). The one-way query reports 53, and their union 93 of 95. The one fabrication both miss swaps a path for another file genuinely read in the same call, so every leaf matches a witnessed row. The stand-alone clean baselines differ by format. On opencode the baseline is 0 of 28 copies. On cline it is 31 findings on 26 of 28 copies, all outside the model boundary. Of these, 26 are final tool results never sent back to the model, and four are outputs cline truncates at about 8,000 characters before sending. The last is one tool call the model streamed as malformed JSON. Cline repaired it and the environment-side writer failed to parse it, a blind spot of that writer on one of 56 runs. The native-record baselines, the 28 + 28 main-grid runs, are identical to the clean halves in all 56, and pairing subtracts them in every pair. The 20 SWE-agent pairs remain uncovered.
paragraphs.zh: cline 和 opencode 上的反向方向。 另外两条单位规则也以相同方式编写，使用手头的配对且没有保留样本，并且由配对的两个部分共享。 对于 cline，单位是助手文本块和 *.messages.json 中的工具调用参数节点，提示除外。 对于 opencode，单位是会话数据库或其转储中的部分行：助手文本、工具输入和输出，排除推理、步骤和补丁部分。 56 份副本中有 10 份被折叠，因此各行按列形状分类，而非表头。 楼层、层级、折叠分割和配对差异与前两种格式相同。 在 56 对数据中，反向方向报告 cline 有 16 对（删除 0/11，重写 7/7，捏造 9/10）。 它报告 opencode 有 20 对（删除 0/8，重写 7/7，捏造 13/13）。 每次检测都落在被修改的单位上。 与单向查询的并集为 27/28 和 28/28。 在四种格式中，115 对数据中有 95 对，反向方向报告有 56 对（删除 0/38，重写 22/22，捏造 34/35）。 单向查询报告有 53 对，它们的并集为 93/95。 唯一一次捏造遗漏的情况是，将一条路径交换为同一调用中实际读取的另一个文件，因此每个节点都与一个已观测到的行匹配。 独立的干净基线因格式而异。 在 opencode 上，基线为 0/28 份副本。 在 cline 上，基线为 26/28 份副本中的 31 项发现，全部位于模型边界之外。 其中，26 项是最终的工具结果，从未被发送回模型；另外四项是 cline 在发送前截断至约 8,000 个字符的输出。 最后一种情况是一个工具调用，模型将其流式传输为格式错误的 JSON。 Cline 修复了它，但环境侧的写入器未能解析它，这是该写入器在 56 次运行中遇到的一个盲点。 原生记录基线（即 28 + 28 个主网格运行）在所有 56 对数据中与干净的一半完全相同，并且配对会在每对中减去它们。 剩余的 20 对 SWE-agent 数据未被覆盖。

paragraphs.en: The ledger’s copy of the record against edits made afterwards. The harness-side writer stores the record’s content in the ledger, not only its hash (byte for byte equal to the record file on every run checked). For each of the 115 pairs we compared the harness-side rows written for the clean copy with those written for the altered copy ( bench/tamper/harness_copy_check.py , no model calls): they differ on all 115, across the five harnesses (aider 11, cline 28, mini-SWE-agent 28, opencode 28, SWE-agent 20) and the three alteration types (46 removals, 28 rewrites, 41 fabrications). An edit made after the record was filed therefore shows against the ledger’s copy. The copy cannot help when the record was false as written, since it copies what the harness wrote; that is the case the two checks below measure, with each altered copy replayed into the ledger as if the harness had written it.
paragraphs.zh: 账本中该记录副本与之后所做的修改相对照。 框架侧的写入器将记录的内容存储到账本中，而不仅仅是其哈希值（每次运行时都逐字节核对，确保与记录文件完全一致）。 对于每一对共 115 个样本，我们都比较了框架侧为干净副本所写的行与为修改后副本所写的行（bench/tamper/harness_copy_check.py，无模型调用）：在所有 115 个样本中，五个框架（aider 11、cline 28、mini-SWE-agent 28、opencode 28、SWE-agent 20）和三种修改类型（46 处删除、28 处重写、41 处捏造）均存在差异。 因此，在记录存档之后所做的修改会反映在账本副本中。 如果记录本身写入时就是错误的，该副本也无能为力，因为它只是复制了框架所写的内容；下方的两项检查正是为了衡量这种情况，其中每个修改后的副本都被重新写入账本，仿佛是由框架写入的。
