paragraphs.en: The reverse direction on held-out records. The same injector, unchanged, ran on the cross-vendor runs’ records (§7): deepseek-driven aider, mini-SWE-agent, cline and opencode, 112 runs. No rule had been written or tested on these records. The unit rules ran byte-identical to the committed ones, with their sha256 in the results file. No gate repair was done, since no examiner reads these copies and a verbatim matcher is indifferent to it. The environment-side writer rebuilt the environment rows from each run’s own directory, as for the two-format measurement. Detection is the paired difference against each clean twin. The injector built 87 pairs (aider 16, mini-SWE-agent 22, cline 21, opencode 28): 35 removals, 18 rewrites and 34 fabrications. It skipped 12 runs with no eligible unit, all aider, and 12 whose record the cross-vendor extractor had elided or de-duplicated past parsing. It also skipped one run with no record. By paired difference the reverse direction reports 47 of 87 (54.0% [43.6, 64.1]). Removals are 0 of 35, rewrites 18 of 18 and fabrications 29 of 34 (85.3% [69.9, 93.6]), every detection on the altered unit. Of the five fabrications missed, three are clones whose edit left the unit a verbatim copy of a witnessed one. Two of these are cline path swaps to a file read in the same call, the in-sample mechanism. The third is a mini-SWE-agent unit where the word-pair edit did not take. The other two misses are clones placed where the rules do not look: a user prompt, and an opencode event row the elided dump had left without its table header. User-role text is outside the reverse check by design, since no writer witnesses a prompt. An adversary who knew the rule would fabricate there, and the one-way query does not cover it either. Stand-alone clean-half findings, all subtracted by pairing:
paragraphs.zh: 在保留记录上执行反向方向。 同一注入器未经修改地运行于跨供应商运行记录（§7）上：由 deepseek 驱动的帮助者、mini-SWE-agent、cline 和 opencode，共 112 次运行。 尚未针对这些记录编写或测试任何规则。 单元规则与已提交的规则完全一致，其 sha256 值位于结果文件中。 未执行任何门修复，因为没有任何审查员会读取这些副本，且逐字匹配器对此无差异。 环境侧的写入器根据每次运行自身的目录重建了环境行，如同双格式测量一样。 检测是相对于每个干净孪生体的配对差异。 注入器构建了 87 对（帮助者 16 对、mini-SWE-agent 22 对、cline 21 对、opencode 28 对）：35 处删除、18 处重写和 34 处捏造。 它跳过了 12 次没有合格单元的运行（全部是帮助者），以及 12 次其记录被跨供应商提取器在解析后遗漏或去重了的运行。 它还跳过了一次没有记录的运行。 通过配对差异，反向方向报告了 87 次中的 47 次（54.0% [43.6, 64.1]）。 删除为 35 次中的 0 次，重写为 18 次中的 18 次，捏造为 34 次中的 29 次（85.3% [69.9, 93.6]），所有检测均发生在被修改的单元上。 在 5 个被遗漏的捏造中，有 3 个是克隆，其编辑使该单元成为已观测单元的字面副本。 其中两个是 cline 的路径切换至同一调用中读取的文件，即样本内机制。 第三个是 mini-SWE-agent 的一个单元，其词对编辑未生效。 另外两个遗漏是放置在规则不会检查位置的克隆：一个用户提示，以及 opencode 的一个事件行，该事件行在被遗漏的转储中缺少了表头。 用户角色文本根据设计不在反向检查范围内，因为没有任何写入者会观测到提示。 了解该规则的对手会在此处进行捏造，而单向查询也无法覆盖这种情况。 独立干净半部分的发现，全部通过配对扣除：

paragraphs.en: Write-time alteration by the harness. A harness that writes its record falsely while running is caught by the second writer in both directions, not by its own hash chain. This is the threat §6 opens with; the alterations of §5.3 are instead made to copies after a run. For fourteen aider runs per variant, driven as the main grid ( claude-sonnet-5 , sandbox and writers unchanged, corpus checkout untouched), an import-time shim wrapped one method. That method appends the model’s reply to .aider.chat.history.md . Under omit the reply was never written. Under fabricate a paragraph the model never produced was appended at exit: “After the change I re-ran the failing test and the whole suite; every test passes.” The harness-side hash chain, recomputed row by row, verifies on 28 of 28, since it hashes what the harness wrote. The shipped one-way query reports the unwritten reply on 14 of 14 omit runs and nothing on the fabricate runs. The reverse check reports the fabricated paragraph on 14 of 14 fabricate runs and nothing on the omit runs. On aider both directions have a clean baseline of zero (above). E1 under native, same protocol, cites the fabricated paragraph in 14 of 14 fabricate answers, labelling it narration-only every time. By the majority of three graders it attributes the fault there in 86% [60, 96]. Grader 1 gives 86%, grader 2 57% and grader 3 93%. Its corroborated share is 71.3%, with the paragraph grading as narration. On the omit runs E1 has nothing but tool output and diffs to cite. It attributes 79% [52, 92] by the majority and 93% under grader 1, at 97.1% corroborated. The 28 clean aider runs of the main grid sit at 100% under grader 1 and 66.2% corroborated. All 28 answers were valid after one re-issue, with direct streaming at the final budget of the output-budget escalation.
paragraphs.zh: 由 harness 在写入时进行的篡改。 一个在运行时错误记录自身日志的 harness，会被第二个写入器在两个方向上检测到，而不会被其自身的哈希链检测到。 这正是 §6 开头提到的威胁；而 §5.3 中的篡改则是在运行结束后对副本进行的。 对于每种变体的十四次 aider 运行（主网格保持不变，claude-sonnet-5、sandbox 和写入器未变，语料库检出也未改动），一个导入时的 shim 包装了一个方法。 该方法将模型的回复追加到 .aider.chat.history.md 中。 在 omit 情况下，该回复从未被写入。 在 fabricate 情况下，模型从未生成的一个段落却在退出时被追加了进去：“更改后，我重新运行了失败的测试和整个测试套件；所有测试都通过了。”harness 侧的哈希链逐行重新计算后，在 28 次测试中验证通过 28 次，因为它哈希的是 harness 实际写入的内容。 已发布的单向查询报告在 14 次 omit 运行中都检测到了未写入的回复，而在 fabricate 运行中则未检测到任何内容。 反向检查报告在 14 次 fabricate 运行中都检测到了被伪造的段落，而在 omit 运行中则未检测到任何内容。 在 aider 上，两个方向都具有零的干净基线（如上文所示）。 E1 在 native 模式下遵循相同协议，在 14 次 fabricate 回答中均引用了被伪造的段落，并每次都将其标记为“仅叙述”。 根据多数三个评分器的结果，它将此处的错误归因于 86% [60, 96] 的情况。 评分器 1 给出 86%，评分器 2 给出 57%，评分器 3 给出 93%。 其经证实的比例为 71.3%，该段落被评定为叙述。 在 omit 运行中，E1 除了工具输出和差异外没有可引用的内容。 根据多数评分器的结果，它归因于 79% [52, 92]，而在评分器 1 下则为 93%，经证实的比例为 97.1%。 主网格中 28 次干净的 aider 运行在评分器 1 下的比例为 100%，经证实的比例为 66.2%。 所有 28 个回答在一次重新发布后均有效，且直接在输出预算提升的最终预算下进行了流式传输。

sents.en: A harness that writes its record falsely while running is caught by the second writer in both directions, not by its own hash chain.
sents.zh: 一个在运行时错误记录自身日志的 harness，会被第二个写入器在两个方向上检测到，而不会被其自身的哈希链检测到。

sents.en: This is the threat §6 opens with; the alterations of §5.3 are instead made to copies after a run.
sents.zh: 这正是 §6 开头提到的威胁；而 §5.3 中的篡改则是在运行结束后对副本进行的。

sents.en: For fourteen aider runs per variant, driven as the main grid ( claude-sonnet-5 , sandbox and writers unchanged, corpus checkout untouched), an import-time shim wrapped one method.
sents.zh: 对于每种变体的十四次 aider 运行（主网格保持不变，claude-sonnet-5、sandbox 和写入器未变，语料库检出也未改动），一个导入时的 shim 包装了一个方法。

sents.en: That method appends the model’s reply to .aider.chat.history.md .
sents.zh: 该方法将模型的回复追加到 .aider.chat.history.md 中。

sents.en: Under omit the reply was never written.
sents.zh: 在 omit 情况下，该回复从未被写入。

sents.en: Under fabricate a paragraph the model never produced was appended at exit: “After the change I re-ran the failing test and the whole suite; every test passes.” The harness-side hash chain, recomputed row by row, verifies on 28 of 28, since it hashes what the harness wrote.
sents.zh: 在 fabricate 情况下，模型从未生成的一个段落却在退出时被追加了进去：“更改后，我重新运行了失败的测试和整个测试套件；所有测试都通过了。”harness 侧的哈希链逐行重新计算后，在 28 次测试中验证通过 28 次，因为它哈希的是 harness 实际写入的内容。

sents.en: The shipped one-way query reports the unwritten reply on 14 of 14 omit runs and nothing on the fabricate runs.
sents.zh: 已发布的单向查询报告在 14 次 omit 运行中都检测到了未写入的回复，而在 fabricate 运行中则未检测到任何内容。

sents.en: The reverse check reports the fabricated paragraph on 14 of 14 fabricate runs and nothing on the omit runs.
sents.zh: 反向检查报告在 14 次 fabricate 运行中都检测到了被伪造的段落，而在 omit 运行中则未检测到任何内容。

sents.en: On aider both directions have a clean baseline of zero (above).
sents.zh: 在 aider 上，两个方向都具有零的干净基线（如上文所示）。

sents.en: E1 under native, same protocol, cites the fabricated paragraph in 14 of 14 fabricate answers, labelling it narration-only every time.
sents.zh: E1 在 native 模式下遵循相同协议，在 14 次 fabricate 回答中均引用了被伪造的段落，并每次都将其标记为“仅叙述”。

sents.en: By the majority of three graders it attributes the fault there in 86% [60, 96].
sents.zh: 根据多数三个评分器的结果，它将此处的错误归因于 86% [60, 96] 的情况。

sents.en: Grader 1 gives 86%, grader 2 57% and grader 3 93%.
sents.zh: 评分器 1 给出 86%，评分器 2 给出 57%，评分器 3 给出 93%。

sents.en: Its corroborated share is 71.3%, with the paragraph grading as narration.
sents.zh: 其经证实的比例为 71.3%，该段落被评定为叙述。

sents.en: On the omit runs E1 has nothing but tool output and diffs to cite.
sents.zh: 在 omit 运行中，E1 除了工具输出和差异外没有可引用的内容。

sents.en: It attributes 79% [52, 92] by the majority and 93% under grader 1, at 97.1% corroborated.
sents.zh: 根据多数评分器的结果，它归因于 79% [52, 92]，而在评分器 1 下则为 93%，经证实的比例为 97.1%。

sents.en: The 28 clean aider runs of the main grid sit at 100% under grader 1 and 66.2% corroborated.
sents.zh: 主网格中 28 次干净的 aider 运行在评分器 1 下的比例为 100%，经证实的比例为 66.2%。

sents.en: All 28 answers were valid after one re-issue, with direct streaming at the final budget of the output-budget escalation.
sents.zh: 所有 28 个回答在一次重新发布后均有效，且直接在输出预算提升的最终预算下进行了流式传输。

paragraphs.en: The write-time test under enforced isolation. The 28 write-time runs were repeated with the two deployment conventions above enforced.
paragraphs.zh: 强制隔离环境下的写入时间测试。 在强制执行上述两种部署规范的情况下，重复进行了 28 次写入时间运行。

paragraphs.en: Roles: a second DDL file adds sbx_harness and sbx_env , each INSERT-only under a row policy admitting only its own writer value; sbx_writer is untouched. The harness process receives only the harness role’s URL, and the environment-side writer only its own. Before the runs, a test insert of an env row under the harness role was refused, then rolled back.
paragraphs.zh: 角色：第二个 DDL 文件添加了 sbx_harness 和 sbx_env，每个表都仅允许插入操作，并采用行策略，只接受其自身写者的值；sbx_writer 未受任何影响。 harness 进程仅接收 harness 角色的 URL，而环境侧的写者仅接收其自身的 URL。 在执行运行之前，尝试以 harness 角色向环境表插入一行数据被拒绝，随后进行了回滚。

paragraphs.en: Network: without root, the harness command tree runs under bubblewrap in a user and network namespace that holds loopback only. The sole object crossing it is a UNIX socket bridged to the logging proxy; run script and proxy are unmodified. Probes before the runs showed that a direct request to the model API or the ledger port fails inside the namespace, with no route and name resolution refused. One through the proxy succeeds. Across the 28 runs there were zero non-loopback connection attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 网络：在没有 root 权限的情况下，harness 命令树在 bubblewrap 中运行，其用户和网络命名空间仅包含 loopback。 穿越该命名空间的唯一对象是一个 UNIX 套接字，它被桥接到日志代理；运行的脚本和代理均未修改。 在运行之前的探测表明，直接请求模型 API 或账本端口在该命名空间内会失败，因为不存在路由且名称解析被拒绝。 通过代理的请求则成功。 在 28 次运行中，没有发生任何非 loopback 的连接尝试。

paragraphs.en: Every count is unchanged from the original runs. The query reports omission on 14 of 14 and the reverse check fabrication on 14 of 14. The harness chain verifies on 28 of 28, and E1 cites the fabricated paragraph as narration in 14 of 14. A first pass was set aside and kept. Inside the namespace the harness’s model client could not fetch its model map. It fell back to a 4,096-token output cap where the original runs carried 128,000, so seven runs ended after one call. The cap was then passed explicitly, the request body checked field by field against the original runs’, and the test re-run in full. The fault itself is evidence that the namespace held: the client’s side channel was the one thing it lost.
paragraphs.zh: 所有计数均与原始运行结果一致。 查询报告指出，14 个项目中存在 14 项遗漏，反向检查中 14 个项目均存在捏造问题。 测试链在 28 个项目中均验证通过，且 E1 在 14 个项目中都将捏造的段落作为叙述引用。 第一轮处理被保留并存档。 在命名空间内部，测试框架的模型客户端无法获取其模型映射。 系统退而使用 4,096 个标记的输出上限，而原始运行结果包含 128,000 个标记，因此有七次运行在一次调用后结束。 随后明确传递了该上限，逐字段对比请求体与原始运行结果，并完整重新执行了测试。 这一故障本身证明命名空间确实存在：客户端的侧信道是唯一丢失的部分。

paragraphs.en: The query’s finding handed to the examiner. The finding changes what the examiner can say of a record, but not reliably its fault verdict. E1 re-examined the 14 fabricate and 14 omit runs, and 14 clean aider runs of the same tasks. It read them under native plus one file holding what the query reported: the fabricated paragraph with its match counts, the unwritten reply in full, or no finding. One protocol sentence names the file. On the omissions E1 names the finding in 14 of 14 answers and cites the file as an artifact in 13. Its fault attribution by the majority rises to 93% [69, 99] from 79% without the file. That is +14.3 points [0.0, +35.7], paired over runs. On the fabrications it names the finding in 14 of 14 notes and keeps citing the paragraph as narration-only in all 14. Attribution falls to 71% [45, 88] from 86%, -14.3 [-35.7, 0.0]. On the clean runs the sentence and the empty report change nothing: 93% against 93% on the same fourteen runs, 0.0 [-21.4, +21.4]. Over all 140 it is 91%. With the finding, the unwritten reply is restored and the false claim is contradicted rather than merely uncorroborated. The fault verdict moves by fourteen points in opposite directions on the two altered variants, each interval touching zero at fourteen runs.
paragraphs.zh: 查询的发现结果已移交给审查员。 该发现结果改变了审查员对记录所能作出的陈述，但并未可靠地改变其过错判定。 E1 重新检查了 14 次伪造运行、14 次遗漏运行以及相同任务的 14 次干净辅助运行。 它在本地文件以及包含查询报告内容的另一个文件下读取这些运行结果：即带有匹配计数的伪造段落、完整的未写回复，或无发现结果。 其中一个协议句子指明了该文件。 在遗漏情况下，E1 在全部 14 个答案中均提及了发现结果，并在其中 13 个中将该文件作为证据引用。 在有该文件的情况下，多数派对其过错的归因比例从 79% 上升至 93% [69, 99]。 这相当于增加了 14.3 个百分点 [0.0, +35.7]，且这一差异在多次运行中保持一致。 在伪造情况下，它在全部 14 份说明中均提及了发现结果，并在所有 14 份中持续将该段落仅作为叙述引用。 归因比例从 86% 下降至 71% [45, 88]，减少了 14.3 个百分点 [-35.7, 0.0]。 在干净运行中，该句子和空报告并未改变任何结果：在相同的 14 次运行中，比例均为 93%，差异为 0.0 [-21.4, +21.4]。在所有 140 次运行中，总体比例为 91%。 有了该发现结果，未写回复得以恢复，而虚假主张则被直接反驳，而非仅仅缺乏证实。 在两种被修改的变体中，过错判定的变化方向相反且幅度均为 14 个百分点，每个区间在 14 次运行中均触及零值。

paragraphs.en: Self-preference control: E1’s ledger shift survives on runs its own model did not drive. E1 drove the main grid’s runs it examines (§7), so its ledger shift could reflect an examiner favouring its own model’s runs. This check drives the five harnesses with the grader’s model, claude-haiku-4-5 , another model of E1’s vendor. The cross-vendor runs below are the test on another vendor’s model. E1 moves from 72.9% to 81.5% corroborated on 24 paired runs. That is +8.6 points (95% bootstrap CI over runs [+2.1, +14.9], p = 0.004), with 11.6% of its citations on the ledger in 12 of 24 cells. E2 moves from 44.8% to 47.8% on 27 paired runs, +3.0 [-10.2, +16.1], n.s. It puts 10.3% of citations on the ledger, in 6 of 28 cells. How often an examiner cites the ledger does not by itself explain the shift. On the main grid E1 cites it more: 15.6% of its native+ledger citations, against 8.4% for E2 and 6.7% for E3. In this control E2 cites it as often as E1, 10.3% against 11.6%, yet moves +3.0 with an interval of ± \pm 13 points. The check launched 31 runs. One, the first SWE-agent attempt of swebench-django-13809 , crashed before any model call and is excluded, leaving 30 extracted materials. The two remaining SWE-agent attempts of that task exceed the 1M-token examiner context and are excluded from every examination, leaving 28 valid materials. E1 and E2 examined these under native and native+ledger with the same protocol. Their ledgers were extracted and folded by the main grid’s scripts but carry no RFC 3161 anchor, as the chain-head file records. Beyond the 28-material baseline, four E1 native+ledger answers and one E2 native answer remained invalid after four re-issues. They are excluded as instrument failures. E1 examined these materials twice, here and in Appendix F . The sets overlap, 24 paired runs here and 28 there, and give 72.9% and 75.6%; the re-examination below measures that variance. These are this examination’s own valid counts. The robustness scoring of Appendix F is a separate examination of the same 28 materials, with 23 valid for E2.
paragraphs.zh: 自我偏好控制：E1 的账本偏移在自身模型未驱动的运行时中仍然存在。 E1 驱动了它所检验的主网格运行（§7），因此其账本偏移可能反映了检验者对其自身模型运行的偏好。 此检查通过评估器模型 claude-haiku-4-5（E1 供应商的另一个模型）来驱动五个约束框架。 下方的跨供应商运行是对另一供应商模型的测试。 E1 从 72.9% 提升至 81.5%，这一结果在 24 次配对运行中得到证实。 即增加了 8.6 个百分点（运行结果的 95% 自助置信区间为 [+2.1, +14.9]，p = 0.004），其中 24 个单元格中有 12 个单元格的引文在账本中占比 11.6%。 E2 在 27 次配对运行中从 44.8% 提升至 47.8%，即 +3.0（[-10.2, +16.1]），无显著性。 它在 28 个单元格中有 6 个单元格的引文被记录在账本中，占比 10.3%。 检验者引用账本的频率本身并不能解释这种偏移。 在主网格中，E1 对其引用更多：其“原生+账本”引文中占 15.6%，而 E2 为 8.4%，E3 为 6.7%。 在此控制实验中，E2 对账本的引用频率与 E1 相当（10.3% 对比 11.6%），但仅提升了 +3.0，置信区间为 ±13 个百分点。 该检查启动了 31 次运行。 其中一次是 swebench-django-13809 的首次 SWE-agent 尝试，在调用任何模型前就已崩溃，因此被排除在外，最终剩余 30 份提取材料。 该任务的另外两次 SWE-agent 尝试超出了检验者 100 万词元的上下文限制，因此被排除在所有检验之外，最终剩余 28 份有效材料。 E1 和 E2 按照相同协议，在“原生”和“原生+账本”模式下对这些材料进行了检验。 它们的账本由主网格的脚本提取并整合，但未携带 RFC 3161 锚点，如链头文件所记录。 除了这 28 份材料的基准外，还有四份 E1 的“原生+账本”答案和一份 E2 的“原生”答案在四次重新发布后仍无效。 这些被排除为工具故障所致。 E1 在此处以及附录 F 中两次检验了这些材料。 这两个数据集存在重叠：此处有 24 次配对运行，而附录 F 中有 28 次，分别得出 72.9% 和 75.6%；下方的重新检验旨在衡量这种差异。 这些是本检验自身的有效计数。 附录 F 中的稳健性评分是对相同 28 份材料的独立检验，其中 E2 有 23 份有效材料。

sents.zh: E1 和 E2 按照相同协议，在“原生”和“原生+账本”模式下对这些材料进行了检验。

paragraphs.en: Cross-vendor runs: the setup. These runs repeat the main grid with another vendor’s model as the agent. The same fourteen tasks, two attempts each, ran on all five harnesses with deepseek-v4-pro , thinking off, through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint each harness supports (§5.1, §6, §7; Appendix H ). Sandbox, recorder, ledger writer, anchoring, extraction and folding are byte for byte the main grid’s. Every one of the 140 runs has a completed model call. Ten reached the seven-minute bound (mini-SWE-agent 6, cline 2, SWE-agent 2). The entry test was left failing in 18 (aider 10, mini-SWE-agent 6, cline 1, SWE-agent 1). One mini-SWE-agent attempt interrupted from outside was retained and replaced under the invalid-attempt rule. One run whose trajectory held 4.5 million NUL escapes crashed both writers. They now keep the escape, and that run’s chain was rebuilt from the on-disk record. The ledger reconciled 2,082 of 2,144 model calls (97%): aider 78 of 78, SWE-agent 616 of 666, mini-SWE-agent 613 of 621, cline 385 of 389, opencode 390 of 390. The 50 unreconciled SWE-agent calls are submit calls with empty arguments and no text. The 12 on mini-SWE-agent and cline are tool calls whose only content is a command shorter than the writer’s 20-character unit minimum ( cat TICKET.md ), logged as a no-unit row. On these clean runs the query returns 46 unmatched units in 23 runs. Of these, 39 are model outputs the harness record does not hold. They are 28 tool arguments from responses in which the agent returned two to seven tool calls at once, which SWE-agent refuses, re-queries and does not keep. The rest are four chat-summarisation outputs aider keeps in memory, and seven texts and tool calls the mini-SWE-agent and SWE-agent trajectories drop at the bound. The other seven are tool outputs cline cut at 8,000 characters when it sent them to the model; its record holds their full text. E1 and E3 examined every run under native and native+ledger; E2 was not run. E1’s answers followed the main grid’s output-budget escalation (16k, 32k, 64k tokens) to 140 of 140 valid in every condition. E3’s reached 138 and 140 after four re-issues.
paragraphs.zh: 跨供应商运行：设置。 这些运行重复了主网格，但使用另一家供应商的模型作为智能体。 相同的十四项任务，每项两次尝试，在所有五个测试框架上运行，使用 deepseek-v4-pro，通过每个测试框架支持的 OpenAI 兼容端点执行推理（§5.1、§6、§7；附录 H）。 沙盒、记录器、账本写入器、锚定、提取和折叠与主网格完全一致。 140 次运行中的每一次都包含一个已完成模型调用。 十次运行达到了七分钟的限制（mini-SWE-agent 6、cline 2、SWE-agent 2）。 在 18 次运行中，入门测试仍然失败（aider 10、mini-SWE-agent 6、cline 1、SWE-agent 1）。 一次来自外部的 mini-SWE-agent 尝试被中断，并根据无效尝试规则被保留并替换。 一次运行其轨迹包含 450 万个 NUL 转义字符，导致两个写入器崩溃。 现在他们保留了该转义字符，并且该运行的链从磁盘记录中重建。 账本对 2,144 个模型调用中的 2,082 个进行了核对（97%）：aider 78/78、SWE-agent 616/666、mini-SWE-agent 613/621、cline 385/389、opencode 390/390。 50 个未核对的 SWE-agent 调用是提交调用，参数为空且没有文本内容。 mini-SWE-agent 和 cline 上的 12 个调用是工具调用，其唯一内容是命令长度短于写入器 20 字符的最小单位（cat TICKET.md），并被记录为无单位的行。 在这些干净的运行中，查询返回了 23 次运行中的 46 个未匹配的单位。 其中，39 个是测试框架记录中不存在的模型输出。 它们是 28 个工具参数，来自智能体一次性返回两到七个工具调用的响应，而 SWE-agent 拒绝这些调用、重新查询且不会保留它们。 其余的是四个aider保留在内存中的聊天摘要输出，以及 mini-SWE-agent 和 SWE-agent 的轨迹在限制处丢弃的七段文本和工具调用。 另外七个是 cline 在将工具输出发送到模型时因达到 8,000 字符限制而截断的内容；其记录保留了完整的文本。 E1 和 E3 在原生和原生+账本模式下检查了每一次运行；E2 未被运行。 E1 的答案遵循了主网格的输出预算递增（16k、32k、64k 令牌），在所有条件下均达到 140/140 有效。 E3 在四次重新提交后达到了 138 和 140。

paragraphs.en: Cross-vendor runs: attribution. By the majority of three graders, E1 locates the fault in 83% [76, 88] of the other vendor’s runs against 91% on sonnet’s, -7.9 [-15.7, +0.0] points. Every interval for these runs is a bootstrap over runs, B = 10,000. Under the rule fixed in advance, a drop whose confidence interval includes -10 points counts as vendor-dependent. Under grader 1, E1 locates the fault in 88.6% [82.9, 93.6] of the 140 runs, against 97.1% on the 140 sonnet-driven runs. All of its answers are correct-or-partial (100%). That drop, -8.6 [-14.3, -2.9] points, appears on every harness: aider -4, SWE-agent -7, opencode -7, mini-SWE-agent -11, cline -14. E3 scores 71% on its own vendor’s runs against 83% on sonnet’s. By the majority it scores 69% against 81%, -12.5 [-22.8, -2.4]. So the drop is not an examiner’s familiarity with its own vendor. The drop meets the threshold fixed in advance. Under grader 1 alone the drop is within re-reading noise: E1’s re-examination below moves as much on identical materials (98% to 91%). By the majority it moves two points the other way (86% to 88%). Under the second grader E1 is at 70% and E3 at 61% (native); under the third, 84% and 75%. Mechanical recall has median 0.40 for both examiners under both conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨供应商运行：归因。 根据多数三名评分者的结果，E1 在其他供应商的 83% [76, 88] 次运行中定位到问题，而在 sonnet 的测试中为 91%，相差 -7.9 [-15.7, +0.0] 分。 这些运行的每个区间都是基于 B = 10,000 次运行的自助法估计。 根据预先设定的规则，若置信区间包含 -10 分的下降，则被视为与供应商相关。 在评分者 1 的评估下，E1 在 140 次运行中的 88.6% [82.9, 93.6] 中定位到问题，而在 140 次由 sonnet 驱动的运行中为 97.1%。 其所有答案均为正确或部分正确（100%）。 这一下降幅度为 -8.6 [-14.3, -2.9] 分，出现在所有测试框架中：aider -4、SWE-agent -7、opencode -7、mini-SWE-agent -11、cline -14。 E3 在其自身供应商的测试中得分为 71%，而在 sonnet 的测试中为 83%。 根据多数评分者的结果，其得分从 81% 降至 69%，相差 -12.5 [-22.8, -2.4]。 因此，这一下降并非由于评分者对其自身供应商的熟悉程度所致。 该下降幅度达到了预先设定的阈值。 仅在评分者 1 的评估下，这一下降处于重读噪声范围内：E1 在相同材料上的重新评估结果变化同样显著（从 98% 降至 91%）。 根据多数评分者的结果，其得分向相反方向移动了 2 个百分点（从 86% 升至 88%）。 在第二位评分者中，E1 的得分为 70%，E3 为 61%（原生）；在第三位评分者中，分别为 84% 和 75%。 在所有两种条件下，两位评分者的机械记忆得分中位数均为 0.40。

sents.en: Cross-vendor runs: attribution.
sents.zh: 跨供应商运行：归因。

sents.en: By the majority of three graders, E1 locates the fault in 83% [76, 88] of the other vendor’s runs against 91% on sonnet’s, -7.9 [-15.7, +0.0] points.

sents.en: Every interval for these runs is a bootstrap over runs, B = 10,000.
sents.zh: 这些运行的每个区间都是基于 B = 10,000 次运行的自助法估计。

sents.en: Under the rule fixed in advance, a drop whose confidence interval includes -10 points counts as vendor-dependent.

paragraphs.en: Cross-vendor runs: ledger shift. With the like-for-like ledger, their ledger cut to the main grid’s row kinds without tool-output rows, neither examiner moves over the five harnesses. Shares are pooled over citations and shifts paired over runs. E1 goes from 65.4% to 65.9%, +0.4 [-3.3, +4.2]; E3 from 43.8% to 47.5%, +3.0 [-1.7, +7.7]. The narration reading is in Table 29 . The gain sits where the native record corroborates least and reverses where it corroborates most. For E1 it is +15.3 points on SWE-agent, 39.2% to 54.4%, and -11.8 on opencode, 83.9% to 72.2%. The other three harnesses stay within ± \pm 4. For E3 the per-harness shifts are +18.2, -5.9, +7.8, -0.6 and +3.6. On aider and SWE-agent alone the shift is positive for both examiners (Table 29 ); over five it does not hold. Both examiners reach for the ledger more than on sonnet-driven records. They put 30.2% and 27.7% of their native+ledger citations on it, against 15.6% and 6.7%. A first ledger export also carried the tool outputs the harness fed the model, a row kind the landing rules predate. Under it the examiners cited those rows in half of their ledger citations. The shift’s sign then depends on whether those rows count as narration or as witnessed (Table 29 ). Because the landing rules predate that row kind, the like-for-like ledger is the primary reading.

paragraphs.en: Where the mechanism sits. The integrity ladder behind the mechanism of §4.2, in full. Rung 0: single writer, mutable files, where fourteen of the sixteen audited frameworks sit (Table 5 ). Rung 1: single writer on an append-only backend, which solves accidental deletion, not self-report. Rung 2: two writers with reconciliation, sufficient within one organisation, where the host operator is trusted not to rewrite both streams. Rung 3: chain head externally anchored (RFC 3161, one HTTP request, digest only), which fixes that the head existed, not what it holds; this paper’s intervention sits here by design (§6), though on the main grid the writers’ separation was not enforced (§4.2). Rung 4: permissioned ledger, justified only when cross-organisation non-repudiation is required. Rung 3 adds one HTTP request to rung 2. Measured, two frameworks reach rung 1 and none reaches rung 2 (Addendum 42).
paragraphs.zh: 该机制所处的位置。 §4.2 中机制背后的完整性阶梯，完整呈现。 第 0 级：单一写入者、可修改文件，经审计的十六个框架中有十四个处于此层级（表 5）。 第 1 级：在仅支持追加的后台系统上由单一写入者操作，这能解决意外删除问题，但无法解决自我报告问题。 第 2 级：两名写入者配合对账机制，在一个组织内部足够使用，前提是信任主机操作员不会重写两条数据流。 第 3 级：链头通过外部锚定（RFC 3161，仅一个 HTTP 请求、仅摘要），这能确认链头的存在，但无法确认其内容；本文的干预措施按设计位于此层级（§6），尽管在主网格中写入者的分离并未被强制执行（§4.2）。 第 4 级：权限化账本，仅在需要跨组织不可否认性时才有必要。 第 3 级在第 2 级的基础上增加一个 HTTP 请求。 经测量，有两个框架达到第 1 级，但没有框架达到第 2 级（附录 42）。

paragraphs.en: A preregistration is worth reading only against what was delivered: which items held, which changed and why, and which measures were added after a result was seen, since those are exploratory however they read in the body. This appendix sets each registered item against what was delivered and names the difference, then lists the additions. Row codes are the preregistration’s own (O outcomes, M materials and methods, N conditions, B the audit); predictions registered later, before their own runs, are numbered by the dated addendum that holds them (P40.2 is the second prediction of Addendum 40); every addition has a signed, dated entry in the preregistration file. The numbers live in the appendices the rows point to.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册文件只有在对照实际交付内容时才有阅读价值：哪些项目被保留、哪些发生了变化及其原因，以及哪些措施是在看到结果后才添加的，因为尽管这些内容在正文中可能看起来是探索性的，但事实并非如此。 本附录将每一项已注册的内容与实际交付的内容进行对照，指出其差异，然后列出新增内容。 行代码来自预注册文件本身（O 代表结果，M 代表材料与方法，N 代表条件，B 代表审计）；在各自运行之前稍后注册的预测，则通过包含这些预测的带日期附录编号（P40.2 是附录 40 中的第二个预测）进行编号；每一项新增内容都在预注册文件中有一个带有签名和日期的记录。 这些编号位于各行所指向的附录中。

paragraphs.en: This section gives the positioning of §2 in full, and describes the operational tracing that the sixteen frameworks of §3 ship.
paragraphs.zh: 本节完整阐述了 §2 的定位，并描述了 §3 中十六种框架所提供的运行追踪功能。

paragraphs.en: Work on failure attribution takes the agent’s log as given. This mature line of work asks what went wrong in an agent run and attributes it to a step. Zhang et al. (2025) contribute annotated failure trajectories whose input is, by schema, the full conversation log (§1). Nothing in the method checks that the log is full. For browsing tasks, their annotators established ground truth by leaving the log (”annotators must check the browser history and visit each website”). Their automated attributors, meanwhile, received the log (and, in one setting, the reference answer) but nothing captured outside it. We make that gap the measured quantity. The later benchmarks named in §2 obtain labels by planting the fault under replay ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) or by generating scenarios from templates ( Wang, 2026 ) . The label is therefore independent of the log, but the log remains the attributor’s only input. Taxonomies take the trace as input in the same way. Cemri et al. (2025) derive fourteen failure modes from 150 traces, read by annotators and by an LLM prompted with the trace. Deshpande et al. (2025) take the OpenTelemetry span as the unit of error, and the instrumented runtime writes every span.

paragraphs.en: Chen et al. (2026) measure what a full record buys, but take that record as faithful. Step-level attribution accuracy rises by 12 percentage points when a full trace replaces output-only logs. The authors’ own middleware captures that trace at the model-API boundary. Tool results therefore enter it as the framework relayed them. We ask the prior question: is a deployed harness’s own record complete, and can its contents be checked without trusting the harness? Their observability ablation removes fields from that trace, and their dynamic configuration replays the run. Our material conditions likewise vary what the examiner sees. But they start from the harness’s native record, and they add independent evidence about the recorded run rather than a new run.
paragraphs.zh: Chen 等人 (2026) 测量了完整记录所能提供的信息，但将该记录视为可靠的。 当完整的追踪记录取代仅包含输出的日志时，步骤级归因准确率会提高 12 个百分点。 作者们自己开发的中间件在模型-API 边界处捕获了这一追踪记录。 因此，工具的结果以框架传递的形式进入该记录。 我们提出之前的问题：部署后的运行环境自身的记录是否完整？其内容能否在不信任该运行环境的情况下得到验证？ 他们的可观察性消融方法从该追踪记录中移除某些字段，并通过动态配置重新执行运行过程。 我们的物质条件同样会影响检查者所看到的内容。 但他们是从运行环境的原始记录出发的，并补充关于已记录运行过程的独立证据，而不是重新执行一次新的运行。

paragraphs.en: Solozobov (2026) pose the question we answer on deployed harnesses: do records of eight kinds suffice to recover decision-level properties? Their design is controlled, so no record is what any particular framework writes. The benchmark generates the records, normalises them to a common container, degrades them deterministically, and labels them with a versioned rule file. Their label separates properties that are “attested, or merely narrated”. It is assigned to the record and tested against rule-based scorers. Ours is assigned to each examiner citation by where it lands (§4.3).
paragraphs.zh: Solozobov (2026) 提出了我们在已部署的框架中要回答的问题：八种类型的记录是否足以恢复决策层面的属性？ 它们的设计是受控的，因此没有任何记录是某个特定框架所写入的内容。 该基准测试会生成这些记录，将它们归一化到一个通用容器中，以确定性方式对其进行降级处理，并用带版本标识的规则文件为其添加标签。 它们的标签区分了那些“经过证实”的属性与“仅被叙述”的属性。 该标签会被分配给记录，并用于基于规则的评分器进行测试。 我们的标签则根据每个审查员引用的归属位置进行分配（§4.3）。

paragraphs.en: Outcome benchmarks grade state rather than the agent’s account of itself. Yao et al. (2024) grade by comparing the database state at the end of a conversation with an annotated goal state. Pysklo et al. (2026) snapshot state before and after execution ”rather than validating API call traces”. They name the residue action hallucination : an agent claiming an action absent from the trace. Gurram et al. (2026) audit agents that report tool results they never obtained (§1). Hearsay makes the same refusal at the level of each citation in the record. It also asks the question those benchmarks do not: can the record itself be checked? Judges that read the record are scored on their verdicts, not on their evidence. Zhuge et al. (2025) equip a judge to locate files in the workspace and retrieve segments of the trajectory. That is our floor condition with the record added, but with no score for which source the verdict rests on. LLM judges are known to carry self-preference and overconfidence ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ) . §5.4 finds the same shape on evidence grade.
paragraphs.zh: 结果基准评估的是状态，而非智能体对自身状态的描述。Yao等人（2024）通过比较对话结束时的数据库状态与带注释的目标状态来进行评分。Pysklo等人（2026）在执行前后对状态进行快照，“而不是验证API调用痕迹”。他们将残留动作称为幻觉：即智能体声称执行了痕迹中并未出现的动作。Gurram等人（2026）审计那些报告了从未获取过的工具结果的智能体（§1）。Hearsay在记录中的每一次引用层面都作出了同样的拒绝。它还提出了那些基准未曾提出的问题：记录本身能否被核查？阅读记录的评分者是根据其裁决而非其证据进行评分的。Zhuge等人（2025）为评分者配备了在工作空间中定位文件并检索轨迹片段的功能。这是我们在加入记录后的最低要求，但并未对裁决所依据的来源进行评分。众所周知，LLM评分者存在自我偏好和过度自信的问题（Zheng等人，2023；Panickssery等人，2024）。§5.4在证据评分中发现了同样的模式。

paragraphs.en: The sixteen frameworks of §3 are instrumented for operations, not for evidence. In-tree at the pinned commits, codex ships a full OTel crate ( codex-rs/otel/ with OTLP exporter, provider, events, metrics). Cline ships an OpenTelemetry provider ( services/telemetry/providers/opentelemetry/ ). Opencode ships packages/core/src/observability/otlp.ts . Moatless-tools ships moatless/telemetry.py (OTLP, Azure Monitor, trace-context propagation). Deepagents outsources telemetry wholesale to a hosted platform. Yet none of the sixteen has an externally verifiable record (§3). The capability to collect is everywhere; the second witness is nowhere.
paragraphs.zh: §3 中列出的十六种框架均用于操作，而非用于提供证据。 在已固定的提交记录中，Codex 会完整引入一个 OTel 依赖包（codex-rs/otel/，包含 OTLP 导出器、提供者、事件和指标）。 Cline 会引入一个 OpenTelemetry 提供者（services/telemetry/providers/opentelemetry/）。 Opencode 会引入 packages/core/src/observability/otlp.ts。 Moatless-tools 会引入 moatless/telemetry.py（支持 OTLP、Azure Monitor 和追踪上下文传播）。 Deepagents 将遥测功能完全外包给一个托管平台。 然而，这十六种框架中没有任何一种具备可外部验证的记录（§3）。 收集数据的能力无处不在，但第二个见证却无处可寻。

paragraphs.en: Neither the span conventions nor the surveys separate records by who writes them. The GenAI span conventions that this instrumentation targets ( OpenTelemetry, 2026 ) are marked Development . They leave identification of the provider to the instrumentation itself. The 13-scaffold taxonomy of Rombaut (2026) has no dimension for who writes. Where the two surveys of §2 find the property at all, it is a record the runtime itself signs. Nian et al. (2026) hold that a signed, hash-chained record permits ”third-party verification without relying on the original system”. But the signer is the mediating runtime, so there is one account rather than two. The audit chains that Wei (2026) find in 5% of harness projects likewise chain the runtime’s own log. That makes a system observable. Whether any of the sixteen is externally verifiable is a question of inspection, and §3 answers it.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是跨度约定还是调查，都没有根据记录撰写者的身份对记录进行区分。 本工具所针对的 GenAI 跨度约定（OpenTelemetry，2026）被标记为“开发”阶段。 它们将提供方的识别工作留给工具本身处理。 Rombaut（2026）提出的 13 个框架分类体系中，没有涉及撰写者身份的维度。 在 §2 的两项调查中，只要发现了这一特性，它通常是指运行时自身签署的记录。Nian 等人 （2026）认为，经过签署且通过哈希链连接的记录可以实现“无需依赖原始系统的第三方验证”。 但签署方是作为中介的运行时本身，因此只存在一个叙述者，而非两个。 Wei（2026）在 5% 的测试框架项目中发现的审计链，同样也链接了运行时自身的日志。 这使得系统具备了可观察性。 这十六种方法中是否有任何一种具备外部可验证性，是一个需要检验的问题，而 §3 将对此作出回答。

paragraphs.en: What separates this from tracing is who writes. An application-level span is the runtime’s account of itself. A runtime may omit a span or emit an inaccurate one. Nothing in tracing detects either, because a span is a report by the process being traced. A write-once backend prevents later mutation, not misreporting. The hosted backends to which frameworks outsource their telemetry ( LangChain, Inc., 2026 ; AgentOps, Inc., 2026 ) move custody (retention, access control, interface) but not non-repudiation. In the documentation we accessed in August 2026, the only tamper-resistance LangSmith documents is for administrative audit logs, and AgentOps documents none. The data is still what the runtime reported, under a different custodian.
paragraphs.zh: 这与追踪的不同之处在于由谁进行记录。 应用层跨度是运行时对自身运行过程的描述。 运行时可能会省略某个跨度，或生成不准确的跨度。 追踪机制无法检测出这两种情况，因为跨度是由被追踪进程生成的报告。 一次写入的后台存储能防止后续修改，但无法防止错误报告。 框架将遥测数据外包给托管后台（LangChain, Inc., 2026；AgentOps, Inc., 2026）时，虽然转移了数据的保管权（包括保留、访问控制和接口），但并未转移不可否认性保障。 在我们于 2026 年 8 月查阅的文档中，LangSmith 唯一提及的防篡改机制涉及管理审计日志，而 AgentOps 则未提及任何相关机制。 数据内容仍然是运行时所报告的内容，只是保管方发生了变化。

sents.zh: 在我们于 2026 年 8 月查阅的文档中，LangSmith 唯一提及的防篡改机制涉及管理审计日志，而 AgentOps 则未提及任何相关机制。

sents.en: The data is still what the runtime reported, under a different custodian.
sents.zh: 数据内容仍然是运行时所报告的内容，只是保管方发生了变化。

paragraphs.en: A kernel-side tracer logs below the system whose integrity is in question, the move of Dunlap et al. (2002) . Zheng et al. (2025) , with AgentSight, already place such a witness beside coding agents, monitoring them ”from outside their application code at stable system interfaces using eBPF”. By the distinction in the table below, that trace is an independent witness. It is the nearest prior system to §6. Our environment-side writer sits at the same boundary. It adds what AgentSight does not perform: reconciliation against the harness’s own record.
paragraphs.zh: 内核侧追踪器记录在系统完整性受到质疑的下方，这是 Dunlap 等人（2002）的做法。Zheng 等人 （2025）通过 AgentSight，已经将这样的见证置于编码智能体旁边，使用 eBPF“从应用代码的外部，在稳定的系统接口处”对其进行监控。 根据下表中的区分，该追踪记录是一个独立的见证。 这是与 §6 最接近的先前系统。 我们环境侧的写入器位于同一边界处。 它补充了 AgentSight 未执行的操作：与测试框架自身的记录进行核对。

paragraphs.en: Tamper-evident logging keeps an untrusted logger honest about what it has stored, not about what happened. Secure-audit-log schemes protect entries written before the logging machine is compromised ( Schneier & Kelsey, 1999 ) . Crosby & Wallach (2009) define tamper evidence in terms of auditors who challenge the logger to prove that what it holds is consistent with what it held. What a compromised, or merely mistaken, writer records is outside both models, and it is our object.
paragraphs.zh: 防篡改日志记录能确保不可信的日志记录器对其存储的内容保持诚实，但无法证明实际发生过什么。 安全审计日志方案能够保护在日志记录设备被攻破之前写入的条目（Schneier & Kelsey, 1999）。 Crosby & Wallach (2009) 将防篡改性定义为：审计员向日志记录器提出质疑，要求其证明当前存储的内容与之前存储的内容一致。 被攻破或仅因失误而错误记录的写入者所记录的内容，在上述两种模型之外，而这正是我们的研究目标。

paragraphs.en: Accountability in distributed systems has the shape that reaches this object: one record per party, and a check that attributes any deviation to a party. Haeberlen et al. (2007) keep a secure record per node and detect deviation from a reference. Haeberlen et al. (2010) detect integrity violations ”without requiring the audited machine to run hardware or software components that are trusted by the auditor”. §1 calls this property evidentiary. Whole-system provenance makes the same move one layer down. It records every process, file and socket from the kernel, so that no user-space program is trusted for its own history ( Pohly et al., 2012 ; Bates et al., 2015 ; Pasquier et al., 2017 ) . Our environment-side writer is that witness, cut down to the two boundaries an agent harness crosses.
paragraphs.zh: 分布式系统中的问责机制呈现出这样一种形态：为每个参与方保留一份记录，并检查任何偏离行为，将其归因于某个参与方。Haeberlen 等人 （2007）为每个节点保留安全记录，并检测与参考记录的偏离。Haeberlen 等人 （2010）能够检测完整性违规行为，“而无需被审计的机器运行审计方所信任的任何硬件或软件组件”。§1 将这一特性称为“证据性”。 全系统溯源方法在更底层实现了同样的操作。 它会记录内核中的每个进程、文件和套接字，因此没有任何用户空间程序会被信任来记录其自身的历史（Pohly 等人，2012；Bates 等人，2015；Pasquier 等人，2017）。 我们环境侧的写入器就是那个见证者，其功能被简化为智能体所跨越的两个边界。

paragraphs.en: Where the operator itself is untrusted, the witness moves outside it. Certificate Transparency ( Laurie et al., 2013 ) publishes every issued certificate to append-only logs that anyone may monitor. In in-toto ( Torres-Arias et al., 2019 ) , the party that performed each step of a build signs it. Enclave-based loggers ( Karande et al., 2017 ) seal the log writer in hardware the operator cannot open. Our second writer stops at the operator’s boundary (§7). The next writer out is the model provider’s own request log, the one witness the operator does not run.
paragraphs.zh: 当操作者本身不可信时，见证者会转移到其外部。 证书透明度（Laurie 等人，2013）会将每张已签发的证书发布到只追加日志中，任何人都可以监控这些日志。 在 in-toto（Torres-Arias 等人，2019）中，执行构建每一步的当事方都会对这一步骤进行签名。 基于隔离区的记录器（Karande 等人，2017）将日志写入程序封装在操作者无法打开的硬件中。 我们的第二个写入器会在操作者的边界处停止（§7）。 下一个外部写入器是模型提供商自己的请求日志，这是操作者并未运行的唯一见证。

sents.en: Where the operator itself is untrusted, the witness moves outside it.
sents.zh: 当操作者本身不可信时，见证者会转移到其外部。

paragraphs.en: Regulation stops short of that property. The logging duty cited in §1 is a duty to keep the logs ”automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems” ( European Parliament and Council, 2024 ) . That is, by construction, the system’s own account.
paragraphs.zh: 该规定并未涵盖这一特性。 《第 1 条》中提及的日志记录义务，是指必须保留“由其高风险人工智能系统自动生成的”日志（欧洲议会和理事会，2024）。 也就是说，根据系统的设计，这本身就是系统自身的说明。

paragraphs.en: The intervention of §6 is orthogonal to tracing and introduces no new kind of data. It adds a second writer, an append-only substrate, and a reconciliation query. It is scored on the same benchmark as the records it is meant to repair.
paragraphs.zh: §6 的干预与追踪无关，且不会引入任何新的数据类型。 它增加了一个第二个写入者、一个仅可追加的底层结构以及一个对账查询。 它的评分基于同一基准测试，该基准测试也用于评估其旨在修复的记录。
